Rescued from abandonment and raised by the King and Queen, Oedipus is still haunted by a prophecy--he'll murder his father and marry his mother.
John Russell, disdained by his "respectable" fellow stagecoach passengers because he was raised by Native Americans, becomes their only hope for survival when they are set upon by outlaws.
After a badly done assignment, a hitman finds himself in conflict with his organisation, and one mysterious and dangerous fellow-hitman in particular.

A young priest is ordered to preside over the wake of witch in a small old wooden church of a remote village. This means spending three nights alone with the corpse with only his faith to protect him.
After being double-crossed and left for dead, a mysterious man named Walker single-mindedly tries to retrieve the money that was stolen from him.
Bathsheba Everdene, a willful, flirtatious, young woman, unexpectedly inherits a large farm and is romantically pursued by three very different men.

movies.a: Per favore, non mordermi sul collo!
movies.s: A noted professor and his dim-witted apprentice fall prey to their inquiring vampires, while on the trail of the ominous damsel in distress.

movies.t: How to Succeed in Business Without Really Trying
movies.s: Armed with the titular manual, an ambitious window washer seeks to climb the corporate ladder.

movies.a: Week End - Una donna e un uomo da sabato a domenica
movies.s: A surreal tale of a married couple going on a road trip to visit the wife's parents with the intention of killing them for the inheritance.
A band of Mexican gun-runners employed by a revolutionary general accept an American into their gang, unaware of his intentions.
A small group of French students are studying Mao, trying to find out their position in the world and how to change the world to a Maoistic community using terrorism.
A scruffy garbage boy becomes the pupil of a famed gunfighter, and the stage for confrontation is set when the gunman becomes unhinged and overruns the boy's town through violence and corruption.
Aging cowboy Will Penny gets a line camp job on a large cattle spread and finds his isolated cabin is already occupied by a husbandless woman and her young son.
A young gunfighter plans to track down and eliminate the bandits who killed his family, and forms a tenuous alliance with an aging ex-outlaw, till the surprising end.
Paul, a conservative young lawyer, marries the vivacious Corie. Their highly passionate relationship descends into comical discord in a five-flight New York City walk-up apartment.
A mysterious artifact is unearthed in London, and famous scientist Bernard Quatermass is called into to divine its origins and explain its strange effects on people.

movies.t: Spider Baby or, the Maddest Story Ever Told
movies.s: A caretaker devotes himself to three demented siblings after their father's death.

At Oxford, Austrian student Anna von Graz (Jacqueline Sassard) is dating fellow student William (Michael York), whom she plans to marry, but she ends up sleeping with two unhappily married Oxford professors instead.
A hapless loser sells his soul to the Devil in exchange for seven wishes, but has trouble winning over the girl of his dreams.
Millie Dillmount comes to town in the roaring twenties to encounter flappers, sexuality, and white slavers.
The story of a man who was shot, robbed and imprisoned who returns to steal a large gold shipment from the man who wronged him. The gold is transported in an armored stage coach, the War Wagon.

movies.a: Agente 007 - Si vive solo due volte
movies.s: Secret Agent James Bond and the Japanese Secret Service must find and stop the true culprit of a series of space hijackings, before war is provoked between Russia and the United States.

movies.t: 2 ou 3 choses que je sais d'elle
movies.a: Due o tre cose che so di lei
movies.s: A day in the life of a Parisian housewife/prostitute, interspersed with musings on the Vietnam War and other contemporary issues.
Famous but unlucky pursuers of Fantomas from France go to weird Scotland for a final attempt to bring the impudent criminal to justice.
A British agent sets out to uncover the hidden facts behind a British government employee's suicide.
Bizarre tale of sex, betrayal, and perversion at a military post.

Marshal Wyatt Earp kills a couple of men of the Clanton gang in a fight. In revenge, Clanton's thugs kill the Marshal's brother. Thus, Wyatt starts to chase the killers together with his friend Doc Holliday.

movies.a: Il massacro del giorno di San Valentino
movies.s: Al Capone's Valentine's Day surprise for the rival Bugs Moran gang in 1929 Chicago.

movies.a: Chi sta bussando alla mia porta?
movies.s: J.R. is a typical Italian-American on the streets of New York. When he gets involved with a local girl, he decides to get married and settle down, but when he learns that she was once raped...
Gaul invaded! Asterix must save the Druid Getafix from the Romans.

The story of the marriage of England's King Arthur to Guinevere. The plot of illegitimate Mordred to gain the throne and Guinevere's growing attachment to Sir Lancelot, threaten to topple Arthur and destroy his "round table" of knights.
After being reanimated, Baron Frankenstein transfers the soul of an executed young man into the body of his lover, prompting her to kill the men who wronged them.

Dr Kilmore is sacked after being discovered in a compromising position on the roof of the nurses' home. The patients are determined not to lose him, and so take on the might of the "cutting" Dr Tinkle and the overpowering Matron.
After a train is robbed of its payroll, an insurance agent and a card-shark team-up to retrieve the loot from the bandits who guard it at a secret location near the Mexican border.
After the animal communicating veterinarian goes too far for his clientele, he and his friends escape their hometown to the sea in search of the Great Pink Sea Snail.
Super-spy Flint takes on a cabal of women plotting to rule the world.
In Hong Kong, the ambassador returning to America meets the Russian countess, a refugee without a passport, who decides to hide in his cabin.

movies.t: Jag är nyfiken - en film i gult
movies.s: Lena, aged twenty, wants to know all she can about life and reality. She collects information on everyone and everything, storing her findings in an enormous archive. She experiments with ...
After his wife leaves him, a disillusioned director dives into the drug scene, trying anything his friend suggests.

movies.a: Il cervello da un miliardo di dollari
movies.s: A former British spy stumbles onto a plot to overthrow Communism with the help of a supercomputer. But who is working for whom?

movies.t: Kaijûtô no kessen: Gojira no musuko
movies.s: Scientists experimenting with changes in weather on a tropical island get more than they bargained for when Godzilla shows up to battle humongous insects and protect his newborn child.
In an early spy spoof, aging Sir James Bond comes out of retirement to take on SMERSH.

movies.t: Il buono, il brutto, il cattivo
movies.s: A bounty hunting scam joins two men in an uneasy alliance against a third in a race to find a fortune in gold buried in a remote cemetery.
En route to Delhi to receive an award, a Bengali film star reevaluates his success through his fellow passengers, dreams and past experiences.
The Russian aristocracy prepares for the French invasion on the eve of 1812.
In the 1950s, fear and violence escalate as the people of Algiers fight for independence from the French government.
The life, times and afflictions of the fifteenth-century Russian iconographer St. Andrei Rublev.

A very good cop tries to catch a very insidious and extremely clever serial car thief. The bitter irony is that the thief is not very clever, absolutely not insidious, and moreover - a virtuous person and his friend.
A nurse is put in charge of a mute actress and finds that their personae are melding together.
Through his unconscionable actions against others, a sociopath samurai builds a trail of vendettas that follow him closely.

movies.a: Tutte le ore feriscono... l'ultima uccide
movies.s: A gangster escapes jail and quickly makes plans to continue his criminal ways elsewhere, but a determined inspector is closing in.
Several ordinary Frenchmen, helping British pilots avoid Nazi captivity, go on epic voyage through the occupied country to the Swiss border.

movies.a: Chi ha paura di Virginia Woolf?
movies.s: A bitter, aging couple, with the help of alcohol, use their young houseguests to fuel anguish and emotional pain towards each other over the course of a distressing night.
A group of misfits, headed by an incompetent knight named Brancaleone, set out to reach the small town of Aurocastro so that their leader can take possession of the fief.
The story of a mistreated donkey and the people around him. A study on saintliness and a sister piece to Bresson's Mouchette.

movies.a: Un uomo per tutte le stagioni
movies.s: The story of Sir Thomas More, who stood up to King Henry VIII when the King rejected the Roman Catholic Church to obtain a divorce and remarry.
An apprentice train dispatcher at a village station seeks his first sexual encounter and becomes despondent when he is unable to perform.
An unhappy middle-aged banker agrees to a procedure that will fake his death and give him a completely new look and identity - one that comes with its own price.
A mod London photographer finds something very suspicious in the shots he has taken of a mysterious beauty in a desolate park.

movies.a: Come rubare un milione di dollari e vivere felici
movies.s: The daughter of an art forger teams up with a burglar to steal one of her father's forgeries and protect his secret.
A romance between young Parisians, shown through a series of vignettes.
In 1926, a U.S. Naval engineer gets assigned to a gunboat on a rescue mission in war-torn China.
A widow and a widower find their relationship developing into love, but their past tragedies prove hard to overcome, causing them to proceed with utmost delicacy.
During World War I, a British private, sent ahead to a French town to scout for enemy presence, is mistaken for a King by the colorful patients of an insane asylum.
A black girl from Senegal becomes a servant in France.

After realizing that all world is spoiled, Marie and Marie are committed to be spoiled themselves. They rip off older men, feast in lavish meals and do all kinds of mischief. But what is all this leading to?
Two high-spirited young students at St. Francis Academy For Girls keep things hopping for the challenged Mother Superior (Rosalind Russell) and her staff of bewildered Sisters.
Unofficial lawman John Corbett hunts down Cuchillo Sanchez, a Mexican peasant accused of raping and killing a 12-year-old girl.
A man spends a night in a haunted house.

movies.t: A Big Hand for the Little Lady
movies.s: Comedy western in which a traveler bets more money than he can afford in a poker game, and unusual events follow.

movies.a: Non per soldi... ma per denaro
movies.s: A crooked lawyer persuades his brother-in-law to feign a serious injury.
An arrogant Texas millionaire hires four adventurers to rescue his kidnapped wife from a notorious Mexican bandit.
Totò and his son Ninetto are drifting on a road in Italy, when they meet a speaking crow.
The story of George and Joy Adamson and the orphaned lion cub, Elsa, they adopt.
The escape of Bubber Reeves from prison affects the inhabitants of a small Southern town.
A coffin-dragging gunslinger and a half-breed prostitute become embroiled in a bitter feud between a Klan of Southern racists and a band of Mexican Revolutionaries.
In an oppressive future, a fireman whose duty is to destroy all books begins to question his task.
American Grand Prix driver Pete Aron is fired by his Jordan-BRM racing team after a crash at Monaco that injures his British teammate, Scott Stoddard.
A young pilot in the German air force of 1918, disliked as lower-class and unchivalrous, tries ambitiously to earn the medal offered for 20 kills.
In search of help, two wounded gangsters on the run find refuge in the secluded castle of a feeble man and his wife; however, under the point of a gun, nothing is what it seems.
An English cat burglar needs a Eurasian dancer's help to pull off the perfect heist, but even the most foolproof schemes have a way of backfiring.

movies.t: The Russians Are Coming the Russians Are Coming
movies.a: Arrivano i Russi, arrivano i Russi
movies.s: Without hostile intent, a Soviet submarine runs aground off New England. Men are sent for a boat, but many villagers go into a tizzy, risking bloodshed.
The dramatic love story of small-town Mississippi girl Alva Starr and railroad official Owen Legate, set during the Great Depression.
An unrepentant ladies' man gradually begins to understand the consequences of his lifestyle.
A Carpathian village is haunted by the ghost of a murderous little girl, prompting a coroner and a medical student to uncover her secrets while a witch attempts to protect the villagers.

movies.a: Le implacabili lame di rondine d'oro
movies.s: A group of bandits kidnaps the governor's son and demands their imprisoned leader to be set free in exchange.

movies.a: Chiamami domani... che oggi devo morire
movies.s: The sinister Dr Watt has an evil scheme going. He's kidnapping beautiful young women and turning them into mannequins to sell to local stores.
A British Agent is sent to East Berlin to receive a Communist defector, but the true situation turns out to be rather more complicated.

movies.t: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
movies.s: A wily slave must unite a virgin courtesan and his young smitten master to earn his freedom.
A homely but vivacious young woman dodges the amorous attentions of her father's middle-aged employer while striving to capture some of the glamorous life of her swinging London roommate.
Lew Harper, a cool private investigator, is hired by a wealthy California matron to locate her kidnapped husband.
The departure of the German Army from Paris in 1944.
Dracula is resurrected, preying on four unsuspecting visitors to his castle.

A scientist is nearly assassinated. In order to save him, a submarine is shrunken to microscopic size and injected into his blood stream with a small crew. Problems arise almost as soon as they enter the bloodstream.

In the Sudan, in 1884 to 1885, Egyptian forces led by British General Charles "Chinese" Gordon (Charlton Heston) defend Khartoum against an invading Muslim Army led by a religious fanatic, Mohammed Ahmed el Mahdi (Sir Laurence Olivier).
In Victorian England, a fortune now depends on which of two brothers outlives the other, or can be made to have seemed to do so.
Top-notch french restaurant owner Monsieur Septime is involved into crime when one of his famous guests disappears.
An American scientist publicly defects to East Germany as part of a cloak and dagger mission to find the solution for a formula resin before planning an escape back to the West.
The Garrisons live with a Great Dane who thinks he's a dainty dachshund. His identity crisis results in an uproarious series of household crises that reduce the Garrisons' house to shambles.
During the housing shortage of the Summer Olympic Games in 1964, two men and a woman share a small apartment in Tokyo, and the older man soon starts playing Cupid to the younger pair.
Young workers are dying because of a mysterious epidemic in a little village in Cornwall. Doctor Thompson is helpless and asks professor James Forbes for help. The professor and his ...
A mysterious woman persuades two cowboys to help her in a revenge scheme.
When scientists use eco-terrorism to impose their will on the world by affecting extremes in the weather, Intelligence Chief Cramden calls in top agent Derek Flint.
Three cowboys, mistaken for members of an outlaw gang, are relentlessly pursued by a posse.
Story of international intrigue involving a university professor, an Arab prime minister, a ruthless businessman, a beautiful spy, and hieroglyphics.
The Dynamic Duo faces four supervillains who plan to hold the world for ransom with the help of a secret invention that instantly dehydrates people.
An Italian criminal mastermind, impersonating a film director, plans to grab the loot on a beach where a bogus movie is being filmed.
After a series of misunderstandings, the head of an aerospace research laboratory begins to suspect his new girlfriend is a Russian spy.
In the near future, leftist writer Paula goes from Paris to the French town of Atlantic-Cité when she learns of the death of a former colleague and lover, Richard P. Is she there to ...

An English woman and her daughter enlist the aid of a cowboy to try and get their hardy hornless bull to mate with the longhorns of Texas, but have to overcome greedy criminals and the natural elements.
A Native American warrior called Navajo Joe seeks revenge on a gang of sadistic outlaws who has massacred the people of his tribe.
Extravagant production of the first part of the book of Genesis. Covers Adam and Eve, Noah and the Flood and Abraham and Isaac.
In the West Berlin of the 1960s, two British agents are killed by a Nazi group, prompting British Intelligence to dispatch agent Quiller to investigate.
In a Cornish village, various locals die from mysterious snake bites, but the coroner rules the deaths as heart attacks, until a family of newcomers starts an investigation.

movies.a: Daleks il futuro tra un milione di anni
movies.s: The Daleks' fiendish plot in 2150 against Earth and its people is foiled when Dr. Who and friends arrive from the 20th century and figure it out.
In
Prehistoric man Tumak is banished from his savage tribe and meets pretty Loana, who belongs to a gentler coastal tribe but he must fight caveman Payto to win her favors.

movies.t: Gojira, Ebirâ, Mosura: Nankai no daiketto
movies.s: A young man steals a boat to find his brother, but he and his shipmates become shipwrecked on a mysterious island inhabited by a giant sea monster and a slumbering Godzilla.
Two survivors of the initial Magnificent Seven outfit, Chris and Vin, recruit four new members in order to re-form the outfit and defend a few Mexican villages from attacks by vicious bandits.
Escaped convict Griffin and his friends ran all the way to Hell...with a penny, and a broken cigarette.
The pointlessly named Batwoman and her bevy of Batmaidens fight evil and dance.
A family gets lost on the road and stumbles upon a hidden, underground, devil-worshiping cult led by the fearsome Master and his servant Torgo.
Three stories about Shurik - a young student. He fights against criminals, falls in love, confuses apartments, passes exams - he lives after all.
In 19th-century Japan, a rough-tempered yet charitable town doctor trains a young intern.
Two bounty hunters with the same intentions team up to track down a Western outlaw.
Halil who is a painter falls in love with a picture which belongs to a daughter of a mansion's owner. One day, the girl comes into the mansion while Halil is looking at the picture.
A carpenter in the Fascist Slovak State is appointed "Aryan controller" of a Jewish widow's store.
A timeless Carpathian story - the young Ivan falls in love with the daughter of his father's killer among the Hutsul people of Ukraine.
The life of a Russian physician and poet who, although married to another, falls in love with a political activist's wife and experiences hardship during World War I and then the October Revolution.
A woman leaves an Austrian convent to become a governess to the children of a Naval officer widower.
In a North African military prison during World War II, five new prisoners struggle to survive in the face of brutal punishment and sadistic guards.
Upon finding a book that relates his grandfather's story, an officer ventures through Spain meeting a wide array of characters, most of whom have a story of their own to tell.
The career of Shakespeare's Sir John Falstaff (Orson Welles) as a roistering companion to young Prince Hal (Keith Baxter), circa 1400 to 1413.
A young man takes drastic measures to rid his dysfunctional family of its various afflictions.
A sex-repulsed woman who disapproves of her sister's boyfriend sinks into depression and has horrific visions of rape and violence.
François, a young carpenter, lives a happy, uncomplicated life with his wife Thérèse and their two small children. One day he meets Emilie, a clerk in the local post office.
A man kidnaps a woman and holds her hostage just for the pleasure of having her there.
Visions, memories, and mysticism all help a 40-something woman to find the strength to leave her cheating husband.
Pierrot escapes his boring society and travels from Paris to the Mediterranean Sea with Marianne, a girl chased by hit-men from Algeria. They lead an unorthodox life, always on the run.

movies.t: The Spy Who Came In from the Cold
movies.a: La spia che venne dal freddo
movies.s: British Agent Alec Leamas (Richard Burton) refuses to come in from the Cold War during the 1960s, choosing to face another mission, which may prove to be his final one.
After a plane crash in the Sahara, one of the survivors says he's an airplane designer and they can make a flyable plane from the wreckage.
Fast-talking wheeler-dealer Corporal King is stuck in a Malaysian P.O.W. camp during World War II and uses bribery and larceny to take de-facto control of the camp.
Criminals have chosen an ordinary man to carry drugs and jewels in his car across the border. The problem is that this man turned out too much ordinary.
An American destroyer Captain is determined to confront a Soviet submarine caught violating territorial waters. Perhaps too determined.
A middle-aged iconoclast, doggedly avoiding the tedium of employment and conventional life, faces the prospect of losing custody of his young ward.
A woman reports that her young daughter is missing, but there seems to be no evidence that she ever existed.
An up-and-coming poker player tries to prove himself in a high-stakes match against a long-time master of the game.
A Naval officer, reprimanded after Pearl Harbor, is later promoted to Rear Admiral and gets a second chance to prove himself against the Japanese.
An accountant suddenly suffers from amnesia. This appears related to the suicide of his boss. Now some violent thugs are out to get him. They work for a shadowy figure known simply as The Major.
During the Civil War, a Virginia farmer and his family vow to remain neutral, but one of the sons is captured by Union soldiers, sending the farmer to his rescue.
During the 1800s, a safari guide, two elephant hunters and their crew run into trouble with the natives in the South African veld when they refuse to offer gifts to the tribesmen.
The biographical story of Michelangelo's troubles while painting the Sistine Chapel at the urging of Pope Julius II.
In the early 20th century, two rivals, the heroic Leslie and the despicable Professor Fate, engage in an epic automobile race from New York to Paris.
Sir
In London, a counter espionage Agent deals with his own bureaucracy while investigating the kidnapping and brainwashing of British scientists.
There's just something not quite right when Bette Davis stars as an English nanny. And is her 10-year-old charge an emotionally disturbed murderer or just an insolent brat?

movies.a: I quattro figli di Katie Elder
movies.s: Ranch owner Katie Elder's four sons determine to avenge the murder of their father and the swindling of their mother.

movies.t: Alphaville, une étrange aventure de Lemmy Caution
movies.s: A U.S. secret agent is sent to the distant space city of Alphaville where he must find a missing person and free the city from its tyrannical ruler.
Beautiful but amoral model Diana Scott sleeps her way to the top of the London fashion scene at the height of the Swinging Sixties.
A varied group of passengers boarding a ship bound for pre-WWII Germany represents a microcosm of early 1930s society.
An American POW leads a group of mainly British prisoners to escape from the Germans in WWII.
Satire on the funeral business, in which a young British poet goes to work at a Hollywood cemetery.
A war pacifist is blackmailed to pose as an SS officer and to disable the scuttling explosives on freighter carrying rubber cargo to be captured by the Allies.
James Bond heads to the Bahamas to recover two nuclear warheads stolen by S.P.E.C.T.R.E. Agent Emilio Largo in an international extortion scheme.
When Professor Marchand, a famous scientist, mysteriously disappears, the commissioner, Juve, immediately suspects Fantomas.
A dramatization of Nazi Germany's final Western Front counterattack of World War II.
A young schoolteacher turns into an outlaw to avenge her murdered father.
After being discredited as a coward, a 19th century seaman (Peter O'Toole) lives for only one purpose: to redeem himself. Based on Joseph Conrad's novel written in 1900.
After a kidnapped bank teller uses a neighbor's wandering cat to send an S.O.S., the F.B.I. assigns a cat-allergic Agent to the case.
Aboard a British train, mysterious fortune teller Dr. Schreck uses tarot cards to read the futures of five fellow passengers.

Three go-go dancers holding a young girl hostage come across a crippled old man living with his two sons in the desert. After learning he's hiding a sum of cash around, the women start scheming on him.

In 1864, due to frequent Apache raids from Mexico into the U.S., a Union officer decides to illegally cross the border and destroy the Apache, using a mixed army of Union troops, Confederate POWs, civilian mercenaries, and scouts.
Ten people are invited to a luxury mountaintop mansion, only to find that an unseen person is killing them one by one. Could one of them be the killer?
A dedicated bachelor drunkenly marries a young woman and immediately lives to regret it.

In the 21st Century, where a human vs. human "Big Hunt" is used as an alternative to war, a veteran huntress agrees to kill a "victim" to get a major TV sponsorship deal, but romantic entanglements between the two complicate matters.

movies.a: La più grande storia mai raccontata
movies.s: An all-star, large scale epic movie that chronicles the life and ministry of Jesus Christ.
On its way to Denver, a cargo of whiskey destined for the miners, is sought after by the Temperance League, the U.S. Cavalry, the local Indians and the miners themselves.
Allied agents attempt to infiltrate the Nazis' rocket research site.
A fairy-tale about a conceited young man and a young woman with a tyrannical step-mother, who must overcome magical trials in order to be together.
Norwegian resistance tries to stop German efforts to produce an atomic bomb component during World War II.
After being chosen to represent France in an international congress, Cruchot and his troops must go to New York, and adapt to its social and cultural aspects.
Aliens from Planet X request the use of Godzilla and Rodan to fight off King Ghidorah, but have a better use for the three monsters.
Somewhere in Central America in 1907: Maria II is the daughter of an Irish terrorist. After her father's death, she meets Maria I, a singer in a circus. She decides to stay with the circus,...
After landing on a mysterious planet, a team of astronauts begin to turn on each other, swayed by the uncertain influence of the planet and its strange inhabitants.

movies.a: Lo strano mondo di Daisy Clover
movies.s: A tomboy turned movie star deals with the cruelty of Hollywood.
A playboy who refuses to give up his hedonistic lifestyle to settle down and marry his true love seeks help from a demented psychoanalyst who is having romantic problems of his own.
An eccentric inventor and his companions travel in his TARDIS to the Planet Skaro and battle the evil menace of the Daleks.
A space capsule crash-lands on Earth, and the astronaut aboard disappears. Is there a connection between the missing man and the monster roaming the area?

An old man goes to visit his wounded son in a hospital, but it turns out that he's already been released and is back on the front lines. Reluctant to return home empty-handed, he tries to follow and find him.
An entomologist on vacation is trapped by local villagers into living with a woman whose life task is shoveling sand for them.

movies.t: Dr. Strangelove or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb
movies.a: Il dottor Stranamore - Ovvero: come ho imparato a non preoccuparmi e ad amare la bomba
movies.s: An insane general triggers a path to nuclear holocaust that a War Room full of politicians and generals frantically tries to stop.
The lonely wife of a newspaper editor falls in love with her visiting cousin-in-law, who shares her love for literature.
Four vignettes about the lives of the Cuban people set during the pre-revolutionary era.
A technical malfunction sends American planes to Moscow to deliver a nuclear attack. Can all-out war be averted?
A collection of four Japanese folk tales with supernatural themes.
Two women kill samurais and sell their belongings for a living. While one of them is having an affair with their neighbor, the other woman meets a mysterious samurai wearing a bizarre mask.
A wandering gunfighter plays two rival families against each other in a town torn apart by greed, pride, and revenge.
United States military leaders plot to overthrow the President because he supports a nuclear disarmament treaty and they fear a Soviet sneak attack.
A gangster gets released from prison and has to cope with the recent shifts of power between the gangs, while taking care of a thrill-seeking young woman, who got in bad company while gambling.
King Henry II of England comes to terms with his affection for his close friend and confidant Thomas Becket, who finds his true honor by observing God's divine will rather than the King's.
In turn of the century London, a magical nanny employs music and adventure to help two neglected children become closer to their father.
Snobbish phonetics Professor Henry Higgins agrees to a wager that he can make flower girl Eliza Doolittle presentable in high society.
A young woman separated from her lover by war faces a life-altering decision.
The life of Jesus Christ according to the Gospel of Matthew. Pasolini shows Christ as a Marxist avant-la-lettre and therefore uses half of the text of Matthew.
In 1944, a German colonel loads a train with French art treasures to send to Germany. The Resistance must stop it without damaging the cargo.
An uptight English writer travelling to Crete, on a matter of business, finds his life changed forever when he meets the gregarious Alexis Zorba.
Two crooks with a fondness for old Hollywood B-movies convince a languages student to help them commit a robbery.
While investigating a gold magnate's smuggling, James Bond uncovers a plot to contaminate the Fort Knox gold reserve.
Outnumbered British soldiers do battle with Zulu warriors at Rorke's Drift.
A Jewish pawnbroker, victim of Nazi persecution, loses all faith in his fellow man until he realizes too late the tragedy of his actions.
In an industrial area, Giuliana, an unstable woman, attempts to cope with life by starting an affair with a co-worker at the plant her husband manages.
Over two "typical" days in the life of
An aging, reclusive Southern belle plagued by a horrifying family secret descends into madness after the arrival of a lost relative.
A defrocked Episcopal clergyman leads a bus-load of middle-aged Baptist women on a tour of the Mexican coast and comes to terms with the failure haunting his life.
A medium and her husband stage a kidnapping in order for her to pretend to solve the crime and achieve fame.

movies.t: Le journal d'une femme de chambre
movies.s: A sophisticated and self-assured woman from Paris joins a middle-class rural estate as a maid and causes quite a stir among the variously uptight, perverse and violent inhabitants.
The rich man Domenico and Filumena, a penniless prostitute, share great part of their lives in the immediate post WWII Italy.

Pierre Lachenay is a well-known publisher and lecturer, married with Franca and father of Sabine, around 10. He meets an air hostess, Nicole. They start a love affair, which Pierre is hiding, but he cannot stand staying away from her.
Inspector Jacques Clouseau investigates the murder of Mr. Benjamin Ballon's driver at a country estate.
During World War II, a man persuaded to live on an isolated island and spot aircraft finds himself responsible for a teacher and several students, all female.
In the elegant world of artists and musicians, Gertrud ends her marriage to Gustav and takes a lover, the composer Erland Jansson.
Germans kidnap an American major and try to convince him that World War II is over, so that they can get details about the Allied invasion of Europe out of him.
An American Naval Officer's talent for living the good life in wartime is challenged when he falls in love and is sent on a dangerous mission.

The working-class twin sister of a callous, wealthy woman impulsively murders her out of revenge and assumes her identity. But impersonating her dead twin is more complicated and risky than she anticipated.

movies.t: Deus e o Diabo na Terra do Sol
movies.a: Il dio nero e il diavolo biondo
movies.s: After killing his employer when said employer tries to cheat him out of his payment, a man becomes an outlaw and starts following a self-proclaimed saint.
Kelly's path towards happiness is thrown amiss when she witnesses a shocking event, which threatens not just her happiness, but her mental health as well.

movies.t: Une femme mariée: Suite de fragments d'un film tourné en 1964
movies.s: A superifical woman finds conflict choosing between her abusive husband and her vain lover.
A mysterious circus comes to a western town bearing wonders and characters that entertain the inhabitants and teach valuable lessons.
Gendarme Ludovic Cruchot is re-assigned to the French Riviera seaside resort town of Saint-Tropez where petty criminals and his own daughter give him a hard time.
The author of a best-selling fishing guide is actually incredibly inexperienced when it comes to the sport, which causes mayhem when he is entered into a competition.
Mark marries Marnie although she is a habitual thief and has serious psychological problems, and tries to help her confront and resolve them.
When Miss Jane Marple (Dame Margaret Rutherford) joins a theatrical company after a blackmailer is murdered, several members of the troupe are also dispatched by this mysterious killer.
A masked, shadowy killer brutally murders the models of a scandalous fashion house in Rome.
A young man comes to the rescue of his girlfriend abducted by thieves and brought to Rio. An extravagant adventure ensues.
Surprised that their contract victim didn't try to run away from them, two professional hit men try to find out who hired them and why.

After Miss Jane Marple (Dame Margaret Rutherford) is made a trustee of a merchant marine training vessel, a fellow trustee is poisoned, and ship's officers are later murdered after she comes on board.
The best men of France - a brave journalist and an extremely energetic commissioner - attack the trail of a mysterious criminal mastermind.
Jealous piano teacher Orville Spooner sends his beautiful wife, Zelda, away for the night while he tries to sell a song to famous nightclub singer Dino, who is stranded in town.

movies.t: The Masque of the Red Death
movies.s: A European prince terrorizes the local peasantry while using his castle as a refuge against the "Red Death" plague that stalks the land.
A hypochondriac believes he is dying and makes plans for his wife which she discovers and misunderstands.
A conman gets mixed up with a group of thieves who plan to rob an Istanbul museum to steal a jewelled dagger.

movies.a: La signora e i suoi mariti
movies.s: A four-time widow discusses her four marriages, in which all of her husbands became incredibly rich and died prematurely because of their drive to be rich.
When a disease turns all of humanity into the living dead, the last man on earth becomes a reluctant vampire hunter.
The Cheyenne, tired of broken U.S. government promises, head for their ancestral lands but a sympathetic cavalry officer is tasked to bring them back to their reservation.
After a twenty-year stay at an asylum for a double murder, a mother returns to her estranged daughter where suspicions arise about her behavior.

movies.a: Voglio essere amata in un letto d'ottone
movies.s: A poor, uneducated mountain girl leaves her cabin in search of respect, a wealthy husband, and a better life in this fictionalized biopic of Margaret "Molly" Brown, who survived the 1912 sinking of the RMS Titanic.

movies.a: Ehi Cesare, vai da Cleopatra? Hai chiuso...
movies.s: Two Britons, Hengist and Horsa, are captured and enslaved by invading Romans and taken to Rome. One of their first encounters in Rome leaves Hengist being mistaken for a fighter, and gets drafted into the Royal Guard to protect Caesar.

movies.t: The Fall of the Roman Empire
movies.s: The death of Marcus Aurelius leads to a succession crisis, in which the deceased emperor's son, Commodus, demonstrates that he is unwilling to let anything undermine his claim to the Roman Empire.

movies.t: San daikaijû: Chikyû saidai no kessen
movies.s: After a meteorite unleashes a three-headed beast upon Tokyo, Mothra tries to unite with Godzilla and Rodan to battle the extraterrestrial threat.

movies.a: La vita privata di Henry Orient
movies.s: A mischievous, adventuresome fourteen-year-old girl and her best friend begin following an eccentric concert pianist around New York City after she develops a crush on him.

When a spaceship lands on the moon, it is hailed as a new accomplishment, before it becomes clear that a Victorian party completed the journey in 1899, leading investigators to that mission's last survivor.
Meek and mild mannered bookkeeper Henry Limpet has few passions in life. It's mid-1941 and he would love to join the Navy but has been rated 4F. His friend George Stickle is in the Navy and...
A man's obsession with his dead wife drives a wedge between him and his new bride.
In the early twentieth century, a Gorgon takes human form and terrorizes a small European village by turning its citizens to stone.
In Prohibition-era Chicago, two rival gangs compete for control of the city's rackets.
Stranded on Mars with only a monkey as a companion, an astronaut must figure out how to find oxygen, water, and food on the lifeless planet.

movies.a: Donne v'insegno come si seduce un uomo
movies.s: A womanizing reporter for a sleazy tabloid magazine impersonates his hen-pecked neighbor in order to get an expose on renowned psychologist Helen Gurley Brown.
An RAF squadron is assigned to knock out a German rocket fuel factory in Norway. The factory supplies fuel for the Nazi effort to launch rockets on England during D-Day.
The sprightly young assistant of a Hollywood screenwriter helps him over his writer's block by acting out his fantasies of possible plots.
Race car driver Lucky Jackson goes to Las Vegas to earn money to pay for a new engine for his motor car. Working as a waiter, he still finds the time to court young Rusty Martin.

Anthology movie about three owners of a yellow Rolls-Royce. A British diplomat buys the car for his French wife. A mobster's girlfriend has an affair in Italy. An American woman drives a Yugoslavian partisan to Ljubljana on the eve of the Nazi invasion.

Six impossibly intelligent children from all over the world with dangerous psychic powers hide in a church in England after the military tries to experiment on them. Besieged, they warn the military to back off before carnage ensues.
Upon returning to his home village to continue his experimental research, the destitute Dr. Frankenstein revives his old creature, but a hypnotist wants the monster to control for himself.
Six people are lured into a small Deep South town for a Centennial celebration where the residents proceed to kill them one by one as revenge for the town's destruction during the Civil War.
The Martians kidnap Santa Claus because there is nobody on Mars to give their children presents.

movies.t: The Incredibly Strange Creatures Who Stopped Living and Became Mixed-Up Zombies!!?
movies.s: Jerry falls in love with a stripper he meets at a carnival. Little does he know that she is the sister of a gypsy fortune teller whose predictions he had scoffed at earlier. The gypsy turns him into a zombie and he goes on a killing spree.
A young Air Force lieutenant falls in love with fighter planes while his father, a Congressman and war hero, yearns for him to fly heavy bombers.
An executive of a shoe company becomes a victim of extortion when his chauffeur's son is kidnapped and held for ransom.
Life at home changes when a house-wife from a middle-class, conservative family in Calcutta gets a job as a saleswoman.
Allied prisoners of war plan for several hundred of their number to escape from a German camp during World War II.
A small-town priest struggles with his faith.
A harried movie director retreats into his memories and fantasies.
Depressed Alain Leroy leaves the clinic where he was detoxified. He meets friends, acquaintances and women, trying to find a reason to continue living. Will this help him?
The Prince of Salina, a noble aristocrat of impeccable integrity, tries to preserve his family and class amid the tumultuous social upheavals of 1860's Sicily.
An undertaker marries an old executioner's daughter and, although he doesn't like it, must continue the profession of his father-in-law after his retirement.
A tobacco farmer tries to ruin his competitors crops by diverting water to his property.
Romance and suspense ensue in Paris as a woman is pursued by several men who want a fortune her murdered husband had stolen. Whom can she trust?
Upper-class Tony hires servant Hugo Barrett, who turns out to have a hidden agenda.

A dying mob boss hands over his business to an old friend, Fernand. The boss' assistants want to get rid of the latter. But are the Volfoni brothers and Théo real threats? Ensuing fights and shootouts are more comical than deadly.

Two estranged sisters, Ester and Anna, and Anna's 10-year-old son travel to the Central European country on the verge of war. Ester becomes seriously ill and the three of them move into a hotel in a small town called Timoka.
A young Anatolian Greek, entrusted with his family's fortune, loses it en route to Istanbul and dreams of going to the United States.

Honest and hard-working Texas rancher Homer Bannon has a conflict with his unscrupulous, selfish, arrogant and egotistical son Hud, who sank into alcoholism after accidentally killing his brother in a car crash.
A wealthy San Francisco socialite pursues a potential boyfriend to a small Northern California town that slowly takes a turn for the bizarre when birds of all kinds suddenly begin to attack people.

Despite success on the field, a rising rugby star senses the emerging emptiness of his life as his inner angst begins to materialize through aggression and brutality, so he attempts to woo his landlady in hopes of finding reason to live.
A travelling handyman becomes the answer to the prayers of nuns who wish to build a chapel in the desert.
Screenwriter Paul Javal's marriage to his wife Camille disintegrates during movie production as she spends time with the producer. Layered conflicts between art and business ensue.

Hill House has stood for about 90 years and appears haunted: its inhabitants have always met strange, tragic ends. Now Dr. John Markway has assembled a team of people who he thinks will prove whether or not the house is haunted.

movies.t: It's a Mad Mad Mad Mad World
movies.a: Questo pazzo, pazzo, pazzo, pazzo mondo
movies.s: A group of motorists hear about a crook's hidden stash of loot, and race against each other across the country to get to it.
James Bond willingly falls into an assassination plot involving a naive Russian beauty in order to retrieve a Soviet encryption device that was stolen by S.P.E.C.T.R.E.
In Paris, a former policeman falls in love with a prostitute, and tries to get her out of that life by paying for all of her time.
A salesclerk at Macy's department store finds herself pregnant after a one-night stand with a musician, who does not even remember her. Eventually, they get to know each another and fall in love.
Bent on winning a Pulitzer Prize, a journalist commits himself to a mental institution to solve a strange and unclear murder.
A lazy, irresponsible young clerk (Sir Tom Courtenay) in provincial Northern England lives in his own fantasy world and makes emotionally immature decisions as he alienates friends and family.
Stories about three very different women and the men they attract.
The legendary Greek hero leads a team of intrepid adventurers in a perilous quest for the legendary Golden Fleece.
When a wealthy old man appears to have been "frightened to death" by a cat, Miss Jane Marple (Dame Margaret Rutherford) suspects one of his four relatives, all heirs to his estate, of his murder.
During the Algerian War, a man and woman from opposing sides fall in love with one another.
Wealthy rancher G.W. McLintock uses his power and influence in the territory to keep the peace between farmers, ranchers, land-grabbers, Indians and corrupt government officials.
A poor boy named Arthur learns the power of love, kindness, knowledge and bravery with the help of a wizard called Merlin in the path to become one of the most beloved kings in English history.
The story of three pets, a cat and two dogs, who lose their owners when they are all on vacation. Can they find their way home?

The bumbling Inspector Clouseau travels to Rome to catch a notorious jewel thief known as "The Phantom" before he conducts his most daring heist yet: a princess' priceless diamond with one slight imperfection, known as "The Pink Panther".
A mystery novel-loving American tourist witnesses a murder in Rome, and soon finds herself and her suitor caught up in a series of killings.
Queen Cleopatra VII of Egypt experiences both triumph and tragedy as she attempts to resist the imperial ambitions of Rome.
After having been lost at sea for several years, a missing wife thought long dead returns just after her husband has remarried.
A housewife's sudden rise to fame as a soap spokesperson leads to chaos in her home life.

movies.a: I tre della croce del Sud
movies.s: Comedy subtly dealing with moral issues such as racial bigotry, corporate greed, American belief of societal superiority and hypocrisy.
A former intelligence officer is tasked by the heir to the Gleneyre estate to investigate the unusual deaths of a disparate group of eleven men on a list.
Lost on an island, young survivors of a plane crash eventually revert to savagery despite the few rational boys' attempts to prevent that.

When violent conflict breaks out between greedy railroaders and a tribe of Mescalero Apaches, only two men, destined to be blood brothers, can prevent all-out war: chief's son Winnetou and German engineer Old Shatterhand.
The ghost of a sadistic nobleman attempts to rekindle his romance with his terrorized, masochistic ex-lover, who is unwillingly affianced to his brother.
Charles Dexter Ward arrives at a small village to visit the house he inherited from his ancestor who died there 100 years ago.
As the Nobel Prize winners come to Stockholm to receive their awards, their lives are overturned and perturbed in various ways.

During the 1900 Boxer Rebellion, U.S. marine, Maj. Matt Lewis, along with British consul, Sir Arthur Robertson, develop a plan to keep the rebels at bay until an international military relief force can arrive.
Dishonest undertaker Waldo Trumbull and his sidekick Felix Gillie are creating their own customers when they cannot find willing ones.

movies.a: Le folli notti del dottor Jerryll
movies.s: To improve his social life, a nerdish professor drinks a potion that temporarily turns him into the handsome, but obnoxious, Buddy Love.
A magician, who has been turned into a raven, turns to a former sorcerer for help.

movies.a: L'uomo dagli occhi a raggi X
movies.s: A doctor uses special eye drops to give himself x-ray vision, but the new power has disastrous consequences.
The romantic and chivalrous adventures of adopted bastard Tom Jones in 18th-century England.
As fog delays departure for a group of travellers bound for New York City, they wait at the lounge of London's Heathrow airport, with each passenger at a moment of crisis in his or her life.

Shocked by the death of her spouse, a scheming widow hatches a bold plan to get her hands on the inheritance, unaware that she is targeted by an axe-wielding murderer who lurks in the family's estate. What mystery shrouds the noble house?
An Egyptian caterer kills various women in suburban Miami to use their body parts to bring to life a dormant Egyptian goddess, while an inept police detective tries to track him down.
A young officer in Napoleon's Army pursues a mysterious woman to the castle of an elderly Baron.
A woman seeks revenge on her former lover, who owns a skydiving business.

When a ronin requesting seppuku at a feudal lord's palace is told of the brutal suicide of another ronin who previously visited, he reveals how their pasts are intertwined - and in doing so challenges the clan's integrity.
The story of
An impulsive braggart takes a shy law student for a two-day ride through the Roman and Tuscany countries.
Atticus Finch, a lawyer in the Depression-era South, defends a black man against an undeserved rape charge, and his children against prejudice.
In WW2, twelve year old Soviet orphan Ivan Bondarev works for the Soviet army as a scout behind the German lines and strikes a friendship with three sympathetic Soviet officers.

movies.t: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
movies.s: A senator returns to a western town for the funeral of an old friend and tells the story of his origins.
The story of
A crafty samurai helps a young man and his fellow clansmen save his uncle, who has been framed and imprisoned by a corrupt superintendent.
An aging widower arranges a marriage for his only daughter.

movies.t: What Ever Happened to Baby Jane?
movies.a: Che fine ha fatto Baby Jane?
movies.s: A former child star torments her paraplegic sister in their decaying Hollywood mansion.
The guests at an upper-class dinner party find themselves unable to leave.
After killing a child when his plane crashes in a Vietnamese village, Pierre suffers from delayed stress and partial amnesia. Returning to France, he lives like a vegetable until he meets a...

movies.t: Vivre sa vie: Film en douze tableaux
movies.s: Twelve episodic tales in the life of a Parisian woman and her slow descent into prostitution.
Several romance stories - part funny, part sadly - set in a remote logging camp.
Cleo, a singer and hypochondriac, becomes increasingly worried that she might have cancer while awaiting test results from her doctor.

movies.a: I giorni del vino e delle rose
movies.s: An alcoholic marries a young woman, who he systematically addicts to booze, so they can share his "passion" together.
A former prisoner of war is brainwashed as an unwitting assassin for an international Communist conspiracy.
A young woman meets a vital young man, but their love affair is doomed because of the man's materialistic nature.
A burglar betraying other criminals, prepares for a big heist with a trusted friend that might be as untrustworthy as he.
Decades of a love triangle concerning two friends and an impulsive woman.
Billy Budd is an innocent, naive seaman in the British Navy in 1797. When the ship's sadistic master-at-arms is murdered, Billy is accused and tried.
A surly convicted murderer held in permanent isolation redeems himself when he becomes a renowned bird expert.
The events of D-Day, told on a grand scale from both the Allied and German points of view.

Having renounced her ignominious past, a former streetwalker reunites with her son. However, an extortion scheme endangers her aspirations for a decent bourgeois life. Can she protect him from the same snares that wounded her youth?
Mountain Rivera, a punchy has-been managed by the unprincipled Maish, is mauled in a fight and forced to quit boxing. Can his devoted cutman and a sympathetic social worker help him find a ...
An unassuming office worker is arrested and stands trial, but he is never made aware of his charges.
Senate investigation into the President's newly nominated Secretary of State, gives light to a secret from the past, which may not only ruin the candidate, but the President's character as well.
A lawyer's family is stalked by a man he once helped put in jail.
Harold Hill poses as a boys' band leader to con naive Iowa townsfolk.
A middle-aged college professor becomes infatuated with a fourteen-year-old nymphet.

movies.t: The Loneliness of the Long Distance Runner
movies.s: A juvenile offender (Sir Tom Courtenay) at a tough reform school impresses its Governor (Sir Michael Redgrave) with his running ability and is encouraged to compete in an upcoming race, but faces ridicule from his peers.
A fiercely independent cowboy gets himself locked up in prison to escape with an old friend.

movies.a: Il lungo viaggio verso la notte
movies.s: At the end of a long and hot summer day, members of one family gather in a large house. Everyone has something painful and offensive to say, and their silence is even worse.
The adventures of a blind, gambling masseur who also happens to be a master swordsman.
A man wanders into a seemingly deserted town with his young son in search of work. But after a bit of bad luck, he joins the town's population of lost souls.
On their way to a sailing trip, an aging husband and wife invite along an emphatic young hitchhiker out of sheer patronization.
An ex-union soldier is hired to transport gold from a mining community through dangerous territory. But what he doesn't realize is that his partner and old friend is plotting to double-cross him.
A Joan of Arc's trial reconstruction concerning her imprisonment, interrogation and final execution at the hands of the English. Filmed in a spare, low-key fashion.

In 1787, British ship Bounty leaves Portsmouth to bring a cargo of bread-fruit from Tahiti but the savage on-board conditions imposed by Captain Bligh trigger a mutiny led by officer Fletcher Christian.
Drifter Chance Wayne returns to his hometown after many years of trying to make it in the movies. Arriving with him is a faded film star he picked up along the way, Alexandra Del Lago. ...
A resourceful British government agent seeks answers in a case involving the disappearance of a colleague and the disruption of the American space program.
A man with an asthmatic voice telephones assaults clerk Kelly Sherwood at home and coerces her into helping him steal a large sum from her bank.
A group of men trap wild animals in Africa and sell them to zoos before the arrival of a female wildlife photographer threatens to change their ways.
Inspired by Boccaccio's novellas, each episode focuses on sex, love and seduction in Italy's 1960s, an era of economic growth and major cultural changes.
After a traumatic accident, a woman becomes drawn to a mysterious abandoned carnival.

movies.a: La donna che inventò lo strip-tease
movies.s: Based on the Broadway hit about the life and times of burlesque dancer Gypsy Rose Lee and her aggressive stage mother, Mama Rose.
A family saga covering several decades of Westward expansion in the nineteenth century - including the Gold Rush, the Civil War, and the building of the railroads.
Small squad must hold off German attack.
Mr. Hobbs wants to spend a quiet holiday at the beach, but his wife has invited all their family to stay with them.
Three tales of terror involve a grieving widower and the daughter he abandoned; a drunkard and his wife's black cat; and a hypnotist who prolongs the moment of a man's death.

movies.a: Il giorno dopo la fine del mondo
movies.s: A family leaves L.A. for a camping trip - just before a nuclear bomb destroys the city. As the city descends into chaos, the father must fight to keep his family alive.
A rich businessman and a young woman are attracted to each other, but he only wants an affair while she wants to save herself for marriage.
A small Army of Greeks spearheaded by three hundred Spartans do battle with the whole invading Persian Army.
An artist grows distant from his new wife as an irrational horror of premature burial consumes him.
In the 16th-century Ukraine, the Polish overlords and the Cossacks fight for control of the land but frequent Turkish invasions force them to unite against the common Turkish foe.

A newspaper and television station funded by a pharmaceutical company want a sensation, which happens to be the discovery of King Kong on an island. He is captured and brought to Japan, where he escapes from captivity and battles Godzilla.

movies.a: Il cervello che non voleva morire
movies.s: A doctor experimenting with transplant techniques keeps his girlfriend's head alive when she is decapitated in a car crash, then goes hunting for a new body.
Teenagers stumble across a prehistoric caveman, who goes on a rampage.
His ideals challenged by life as a conscript in war-time Japan's military, a pacifist faces ever greater tests in his fight for survival.
In 1948, an American court in occupied Germany tries four Nazis judged for war crimes.
Viridiana, a young nun about to take her final vows, pays a visit to her widowed uncle at the request of her Mother Superior.
A crafty ronin comes to a town divided by two criminal gangs and decides to play them against each other to free the town.
A day in the life of an unfaithful married couple and their steadily deteriorating relationship.
Recently released from a mental hospital; Karin rejoins her emotionally disconnected family and their island home, only to slip from reality as she begins to believe she is being visited by God.
A married Sicilian baron falls in love with his cousin and vows to wed her, but with divorce illegal he must concoct a crime of passion to do away with his wife.
An up-and-coming pool player plays a long-time champion in a single high-stakes match.
A very young college graduate attempts to obtain a position with a large corporation.
A substantial insurance payment could mean either financial salvation or personal ruin for a poor black family.
The family of an older man who runs a small sake brewery become concerned with his finances and his health after they discover him visiting an old mistress from his youth.
In West Berlin during the Cold War, a Coca-Cola executive is given the task of taking care of his boss' socialite daughter.
In a strange and isolated chateau, a man becomes acquainted with a woman and insists that they have met before.
A rebellious student at a girls' school accuses two teachers of lesbianism.
A young governess for two children becomes convinced that the house and grounds are haunted.
A fragile Kansas girl's love for a handsome young man from the town's most powerful family drives her to heartbreak and madness.
The death of a young man leads to the discovery of a blackmail plot against several gay men in 1960s London.
A hired killer from Cleveland has a job to do on a second-string mob boss in New York. But a special girl from his past, and a fat gun dealer with pet rats, each gets in his way.
A young New York socialite becomes interested in a young man who has moved into her apartment building, but her past threatens to get in the way.
Set during occupied France, a faithless woman finds herself falling in love with a young priest.
A British team is sent to cross occupied Greek territory and destroy the massive German gun emplacement that commands a key sea channel.
A bored young man meets with his former girlfriend, now a cabaret dancer and single mother, and soon finds himself falling back in love with her.
A pregnant teenage girl must fend for herself when her mother remarries, leaving the girl with only a new male friend for support.
A French striptease artist is desperate to become a mother. When her reluctant boyfriend suggests that his best friend impregnate her, feelings become complicated when she accepts.
Two youngsters from rival New York City gangs fall in love, but tensions between their respective friends build toward tragedy.

movies.a: Il rullo compressore e il violino
movies.s: Seven year old Sasha practices violin every day to satisfy the ambition of his parents. Already withdrawn as a result of his routines, Sasha quickly regains confidence when he accidentally ...
When Miss Jane Marple (Dame Margaret Rutherford) reports witnessing a murder through the window of a passing train, the Police dismiss her as a dotty spinster when no trace of the crime can be found.
A wheelchair-bound young woman returns to her father's estate after ten years, and although she's told he's away, she keeps seeing his dead body on the estate.

movies.t: The Day the Earth Caught Fire
movies.s: When the U.S. and Russia unwittingly test atomic bombs at the same time, it alters the nutation (axis of rotation) of the Earth.
The fabled Spanish hero Rodrigo Diaz de Bivar (a.k.a. El Cid) overcomes a family vendetta and court intrigue to defend Christian Spain against the Moors.
A series of misunderstandings leaves an advertising executive with a campaign for a product which has not yet been invented, while he romances his rival in the guise of its inventor.
A divorcée falls for an over-the-hill cowboy who is struggling to maintain his romantically independent lifestyle.
When a litter of Dalmatian puppies are abducted by the minions of Cruella de Vil, the parents must find them before she uses them for a diabolical fashion statement.
A New York gangster and his girlfriend attempt to turn street beggar Apple Annie into a society lady when the peddler learns her daughter is marrying royalty.
After robbing a Mexican bank, Dad Longworth takes the loot and leaves his partner Rio to be captured but Rio escapes and searches for Dad in California.

movies.a: Il cowboy con il velo da sposa
movies.s: Teenage twin sisters swap places and scheme to reunite their divorced parents.
In the sixteenth century, Francis Barnard travels to Spain to clarify the strange circumstances of his sister's death after she had married the son of a cruel Spanish Inquisitor.
Younger generation vs. "older" folks on vacation at an Italian villa.
The temporary physical life of the Biblical Savior, Jesus Christ.

Texas Ranger Jake Cutter arrests gambler Paul Regret, but soon finds himself teamed with his prisoner in an undercover effort to defeat a band of renegade arms merchants and thieves dealing with the Comanches known as Comancheros.
Barabbas, the criminal that Pontius Pilate induced the populace to vote to set free, so that Christ could be crucified, is haunted by the image of Jesus for the rest of his life.
During the Civil War a group of Union soldiers and two Confederates escape the stockade using a hot air balloon and end up on a strange Pacific island.
A corrupt marshal is pressured by his army friend into negotiating the release of white captives of the Comanches, but finds that their reintegration into society has its consequences.
In 18th Century Spain, an adopted boy becomes a werewolf and terrorizes the inhabitants of his town.
A giant, ancient moth begins to attack Japan when coming to the rescue of its two, foot-tall worshippers who were taken by shipwreck survivors.
A clueless, recently single graduate unwittingly takes a job as a servant in a mansion inhabited by dozens of young women.
Tom the Piper's Son is about to marry Mary Quite Contrary. On the eve of their wedding, evil miser Barnaby hires two henchmen to drown Tom and steal Mary's sheep, cared for by Little Bo ...

After arriving back in Hawaii from the Army, Chad Gates (Elvis Presley) defies his parents' wishes for him to work at the family business and instead goes to work as a tour guide at his girlfriend's agency.

movies.t: Voyage to the Bottom of the Sea
movies.s: When the Earth is threatened by a burning Van Allen Radiation Belt, U.S. Navy Admiral Harriman Nelson plans to shoot a nuclear missile at the Belt, using his experimental atomic submarine, the Seaview.
Greedy sailors capture a giant lizard off the coast of Ireland and sell it to a London circus. Then its mother shows up.
After copper miners discover part of the frozen tail of a prehistoric monster in Lapland, scientists inadvertently bring it back to life.
A defecting Soviet scientist is hit by a nuclear explosion near Yucca Flats and roams around as a beast.
A Phoenix secretary embezzles $40,000 from her employer's client, goes on the run, and checks into a remote motel run by a young man under the domination of his mother.
In prison four long-sentence inmates planning an elaborate escape cautiously induct a new inmate to join in their scheme which leads to distrust and uncertainty.
A man tries to rise in his company by letting its executives use his apartment for trysts, but complications and a romance of his own ensue.
Having recently been uprooted to Milan, Rocco and his four brothers each look for a new way in life when a prostitute comes between Rocco and his brother Simone.
A family of four are the sole inhabitants of a small island, where they struggle each day to irrigate their crops.
Based on a real-life case in 1925, two great lawyers argue the case for and against a science teacher accused of the crime of teaching evolution.
An innocent yet pampered young virgin and her family's pregnant and jealous servant set out to deliver candles to church, but only one returns from events that transpire in the woods along the way.

movies.t: Onna ga kaidan wo agaru toki
movies.a: Quando una donna sale le scale
movies.s: A middle-aged bar hostess, constantly in debt, is faced with numerous social constraints and challenges posed to her by her family, customers and friends.
A widow tries to marry off her daughter with the help of her late husband's three friends.
A series of stories following a week in the life of a philandering paparazzo journalist living in Rome.
A vengeful young man marries the daughter of a corrupt industrialist in order to seek justice for his father's suicide.

A small-time thief steals a car and impulsively murders a motorcycle policeman. Wanted by the authorities, he reunites with a hip American journalism student and attempts to persuade her to run away with him to Italy.
A woman disappears during a Mediterranean boating trip. During the search, her lover and her best friend become attracted to each other.
The slave Spartacus leads a violent revolt against the decadent Roman Republic.
A fast-talking traveling salesman with a charming, loquacious manner convinces a sincere evangelist that he can be an effective preacher for her cause.
Tom Ripley is a talented mimic, moocher, forger and all-around criminal improviser; but there's more to Tom Ripley than even he can guess.
In the Italy of WWII, a widow and her lonely daughter seek for distance between them and the horrors of war.
A surgeon causes an accident which leaves his daughter disfigured, and goes to extremes to give her a new face.
Seven gunfighters are hired by Mexican peasants to liberate their village from oppressive bandits.
A young man murders women, using a movie camera to film their dying expressions of terror.
A rebellious, hard-living factory worker juggles relationships with two women, one of whom is married to another man but pregnant with his child.
A man's vision for a utopian society is disillusioned when travelling forward into time reveals a dark and dangerous society.
A TVA bureaucrat comes to the river to do what none of his predecessors have been able to do - evict a stubborn octogenarian from her island before the rising waters engulf her.
Abel Davos is a criminal, hunted in Italy. The police are closing in, so he and his pal Raymond arrange to flee back to France with Abel's wife, Thérèse, and their two young sons. Abel and ...

Charlie is approached by his crook brother Chico, who is chased by two gangsters. Charlie helps him to escape, but he upsets the criminals, so when his brother Fido is kidnapped, Charlie has to take an attitude with tragic consequences.

After World War II, a Highland Regiment's acting Commanding Officer, who rose from the ranks, is replaced by a peace-time Oxford-educated Commanding Officer, leading to a dramatic conflict between the two.
A young girl comes to an embittered town and confronts its attitude with her determination to see the best in life.
An American scholar in Greece sets about improving the prostitute with whom he is infatuated.
A young man finds a very special school. It teaches him how to take advantage of people. He begins to put the lessons into operation.
Respected black cavalry Sergeant Brax Rutledge stands court-martial for raping and killing a white woman and murdering her father, his superior officer.
A disgruntled veteran recruits a group of disgraced colleagues to perform a bank robbery with military precision.
In the English village of Midwich, the blonde-haired, glowing-eyed children of uncertain paternity prove to have frightening powers.
A composer and his wife are thrown into turmoil when a housemaid becomes more than they bargained for.

Valentine "Snakeskin" Xavier, a trouble-prone drifter trying to go straight, wanders into a small Mississippi town looking for a simple and honest life but finds himself embroiled with problem-filled women.

Don Juan is sent from Hell to Earth with a mission - to seduce a 20 years old virgin in order to spoil her pure wedding. The mission becomes crazy when Don Juan falls in love for the first time in centuries.

A vengeful witch and her fiendish servant return from the grave and begin a bloody campaign to possess the body of the witch's beautiful look-alike descendant, with only the girl's brother and a handsome doctor standing in her way.
A Swiss family must survive being shipwrecked on a deserted island.
The World War II story of the Royal Navy's effort to defeat Nazi Germany's most powerful warship.
In Australia's Outback during the early twentieth century, the impoverished Carmody family lives a nomadic life out of their wagon, but the mom and son want to settle, while the dad is against it.

movies.l: English, Indian Sign Language, North Ame
movies.s: A man saves a woman who had been kidnapped by Comanches, then struggles to get both of them home alive.
Upon entering his fiancée's family mansion, a man discovers a savage family curse and fears that his future brother-in-law has entombed his bride-to-be prematurely.

During the Alaska gold rush, prospector George sends partner Sam to Seattle to bring his fiancée but when it turns out that she married another man, Sam returns with a pretty substitute, the hostess of the Henhouse dance hall.

With her mother away for the weekend, a brash and precocious ten-year-old country-girl sets out to explore Paris during a Métro strike, under her uncle's not-so-watchful eye. Can a little girl cause so much chaos in the heart of the city?
In 1836, a small band of soldiers sacrifice their lives in hopeless combat against a massive army in order to prevent a tyrant from smashing the new Republic of Texas.
A young college student arrives in a sleepy Massachusetts town to research witchcraft; during her stay at an eerie inn, she discovers a startling secret about the town and its inhabitants.
In London, a recently wed American woman's sanity comes into question after she claims to be the victim of a threatening stalker.
A group of sinners involved in interconnected tales of murder, revenge, deceit and adultery all meet at the Gates of Hell.
Vampire hunter Van Helsing returns to Transylvania to destroy handsome bloodsucker Baron Meinster, who has designs on beautiful young schoolteacher Marianne.
The state of Israel is created in 1948, resulting in war with its Arab neighbors.
Danny Ocean gathers a group of his World War II compatriots to pull off the ultimate Las Vegas heist. Together the eleven friends plan to rob five Las Vegas casinos in one night.

Mute bellboy Stanley works at the luxurious Fontainebleau Hotel in Miami Beach. In spite of being a serviceable and friendly employee, the clumsy Stanley gets successively into trouble with his mistakes.

movies.a: L'erba del vicino è sempre più verde
movies.s: Victor and Hillary are down on their luck to the point that they allow tourists to take guided tours of their castle. But Charles Delacro, a millionaire oil tycoon, visits, and takes a ...

When billionaire Jean-Marc Clement learns that he is to be satirized in an off-Broadway revue, he passes himself off as an actor playing him in order to get closer to the beautiful star of the show, Amanda Dell.
A university professor leaves his job to become a theater critic, creating problems with his family and friends.
A Manhattan call girl has a tragic affair with a rich married man.

Tulsa, a soldier with dreams of running his own nightclub, places a bet with his friend Dynamite that he can win the heart of an untouchable dancer...but when Dynamite is transferred, Tulsa must replace him in the bet.
A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's carnivorous, forcing him to kill to feed it.
A family inherits what proves to be a haunted house, but a special pair of goggles allows them to see their ghostly tormentors.
A gender-swapped retelling of Charles Perrault's classic, where Cinderfella is visited by a fairy godfather to help him escape from his wicked stepmother and stepbrothers.
Professor Challenger leads an expedition of scientists and adventurers to a remote plateau deep in the Amazonian jungle to verify his claim that dinosaurs still live there.
Survivors of a plane crash on a remote island find it is covered by spiders. When bitten, the survivors start turning into spiders!
This final installment in Satyajit Ray's Apu Trilogy follows Apu's life as an orphaned adult aspiring to be a writer.
A Japanese pacifist, unable to face the dire consequences of conscientious objection, is transformed by his attempts to compromise with the demands of war-time Japan.
As a conscript in war-time Japan's military, a pacifist struggles to maintain his determination to keep his ideals.
A New York City advertising executive goes on the run after being mistaken for a government agent by a group of foreign spies.
Young Russian soldier Alyosha earns a medal, but asks to visit his mother instead. His journey recounts various kinds of love during wartime.
The Italian Army fought against the Austrians during World War I.
After two male musicians witness a mob hit, they flee the state in an all-female band disguised as women, but further complications set in.
After a Jewish prince is betrayed and sent into slavery by a Roman friend, he regains his freedom and comes back for revenge.
A young boy, left without attention, delves into a life of petty crime.
In a murder trial, the defendant says he suffered temporary insanity after the victim raped his wife. What is the truth, and will he win his case?
In 1945, Germany is being overrun, and nobody is left to fight but teenagers.
In the closing days of WWII remnants of the Japanese army in Leyte are abandoned by their command and face certain starvation.
A small-town sheriff in the American West enlists the help of a cripple, a drunk, and a young gunfighter in his efforts to hold in jail the brother of the local bad guy.
The head of a Japanese theatre troupe returns to a small coastal town where he left a son who thinks he is his uncle, and tries to make up for the lost time, but his current mistress grows jealous.
A priest in a poor community lives a charitable life in accordance with his religious principles, but many others do not return the favor.
A French actress filming an anti-war film in Hiroshima has an affair with a married Japanese architect as they share their differing perspectives on war.
An aspiring white actress befriends an African American widow, but trouble arises when the latter is rejected by her daughter, who tries to pass for white.
Two boys begin a silence strike to press their parents into buying them a television set.
Michel is released from jail after serving a sentence for thievery. His mother dies and he resorts to pickpocketing as a means of survival.
After leaving a wealthy Belgian family to become a nun, Sister Luke struggles with her devotion to her vows during crisis, disappointment, and World War II.
A surgeon is assigned the case of a young woman whose aunt wants her lobotomized to cover up a family secret.
A retelling of the Orpheus and Eurydice myth, set during the time of the Carnaval in Rio de Janeiro.
An ambitious young accountant plots to wed a wealthy factory owner's daughter, despite falling in love with a married older woman.
Two wealthy law-school students go on trial for murder in this version of the Leopold-Loeb case.
During World War II, a teenage Jewish girl named Anne Frank and her family are forced into hiding in the Nazi-occupied Netherlands.
A marshal tries to bring the son of an old friend, an autocratic cattle baron, to justice for his role in the rape and murder of the marshal's Native American wife.
Dave Burke hires two very different debt-burdened men for a bank robbery. Suspicion and prejudice threaten to end their partnership.
An interior decorator and a playboy songwriter share a telephone party line and size each other up.
A promising lawyer tries to handle his social and professional problems while climbing the ranks in Philadelphia.

Blaise Starrett is a rancher at odds with homesteaders when outlaws hold up the small town. The outlaws are held in check only by their notorious leader, but he is diagnosed with a fatal wound and the town is a powder keg waiting to blow.
During World War II, a commander finds himself stuck with a decrepit (and pink) submarine, a con man executive officer, and a group of army nurses.

movies.t: Darby O'Gill and the Little People
movies.a: Darby O'Gill e il re dei folletti
movies.s: A wily old codger matches wits with the King of the Leprechauns and helps play matchmaker for his daughter and the strapping lad who has replaced him as caretaker.
In 1863, a Union outfit is sent behind Confederate lines in Mississippi to destroy enemy railroads but a captive southern belle and the unit's doctor cause frictions within ranks.
A naive aristocrat in search of a career becomes caught up in the struggles between his profit-minded uncle and an aggressive labor union.
After a global nuclear war, the residents of Australia must come to terms with the fact that all life will be destroyed in a matter of months.
A bounty hunter escorts a killer to be tried for murder, but allows the man's outlaw brother to catch up with them to have a showdown over a previous shocking murder.
After being snubbed by the royal family, a malevolent fairy places a curse on a princess which only a prince can break, along with the help of three good fairies.
A famous gunman becomes the marshal of Warlock to end a gang's rampages, but is met with some opposition by a former gang member turned deputy sheriff who wants to follow only legal methods.
Jim Wormold, who is a vacuum cleaner salesman, participates as an Agent in the British Secret Service. But he soon realizes that his plans by lying are going to get him into trouble.
