Character study of a Doctor who saves a local criminal from a mob who are trying to hang him, but then tries to control the life of the young man, realizing that he can exploit his secret.
During the Korean War peace talks, U.S. troops fight to retake a hill from the Communist Chinese forces.
A disillusioned, angry university graduate comes to terms with his grudge against middle-class life and values.
When a nobleman is threatened by a family curse on his newly inherited estate, detective Sherlock Holmes is hired to investigate.

movies.t: Journey to the Center of the Earth
movies.s: An Edinburgh professor and assorted colleagues follow an explorer's trail down an extinct Icelandic volcano to the earth's center.
An impoverished backward nation declares a war on the United States of America, hoping to lose, but things don't go according to plan.
A millionaire offers $10,000 to five people who agree to be locked in a large, spooky, rented house overnight with him and his wife.
In 1895, British archaeologists find and open the tomb of Egyptian Princess Ananka with nefarious consequences.

A dim-witted busboy finds acclaim as an artist for a plaster-covered dead cat that is mistaken as a skillful statuette. The desire for more praise soon leads to an increasingly deadly series of works.
A young girl discovers surfing and love (in that order) during one transitive summer.
An obsessed pathologist discovers and captures a parasitic creature that grows when fear grips its host.
A teenage boy is cursed with periodically turning into an sheepdog.
A crazed killer known as "The Bat" is on the loose in a mansion full of people.
Philippe Delambre, the now-adult son of "The Fly", does some transportation experimentation of his own.
The head of a major cosmetics company experiments on herself with a youth formula made from royal jelly extracted from wasps, but the formula's side effects have deadly consequences.
On an isolated island, a small group of people are terrorized by giant voracious shrews in the midst of a hurricane.
A young alien and a teenage earthling fall in love, and plot to stop the alien's race from using Earth as a food-breeding ground for giant lobsters from their planet.
A backwoods game warden and a local doctor discover that giant leeches are responsible for disappearances and deaths in a local swamp, but the local police don't believe them.
A giant lizard terrorizes a rural Texas community and a heroic teenager attempts to destroy the creature.
With the aid of Merlin, Santa Claus must defeat the evil machinations of the devil Pitch to ruin Xmas.

movies.a: La donna che visse due volte
movies.s: A former police detective juggles wrestling with his personal demons and becoming obsessed with a hauntingly beautiful woman.
Lured by gold, two greedy peasants unknowingly escort a princess and her general across enemy lines.
A self-assured businessman murders his employer, the husband of his mistress, which unintentionally provokes an ill-fated chain of events.

movies.t: Cat on a Hot Tin Roof
movies.a: La gatta sul tetto che scotta
movies.s: Brick Pollitt (Paul Newman), an alcoholic ex-football player, drinks his days away and resists the affections of his wife, Maggie (Dame Elizabeth Taylor). His reunion with his father, Big Daddy (Burl Ives), who is dying of cancer, jogs a host of memories and revelations for both father and son.
Depicts the end days of a decadent zamindar (landlord) in Bengal, and his efforts to uphold his family prestige even when faced with economic adversity.
A motley quintet of inept small-time thieves attempt the burglary of a local pawnshop in this Italian farce.
A stark, perverse story of murder, kidnapping, and police corruption in a Mexican border town.
An orphan goes to live with his free-spirited aunt. Conflict ensues when the executor of his father's estate objects to the aunt's lifestyle.
A New Englander arrives in the Old West, where he becomes embroiled in a feud between two families over a valuable patch of land.
Having doubts about the guilt of the obvious suspect in the murder of an eight year old girl, a police detective decides to investigate the case on his own.
A businessman clashes with his elder daughter over her choice of a husband.

movies.t: Ivan Groznyy. Skaz vtoroy: Boyarskiy zagovor
movies.s: As Ivan the Terrible attempts to consolidate his power by establishing a personal army, his political rivals, the Russian boyars, plot to assassinate their Tsar.
On its maiden voyage in April 1912, the supposedly unsinkable RMS Titanic hits an iceberg in the Atlantic Ocean.
Monsieur Hulot visits the technology-driven world of his sister, brother-in-law, and nephew, but he can't quite fit into the surroundings.
As WWII and the German occupation ends, the Polish resistance and the Russian forces turn on each other in an attempt to take over leadership in Communist Poland.
During World War II in North Africa, a medical field unit must cross the desert in their ambulance in order to reach the British lines in Alexandria.
A traveling magician and his assistants are persecuted by authorities in Sweden of the 19th century. Their captures, however, didn't bring victory to those in power.
A newspaper salesman at the train station in Cairo develops an unhealthy obsession with a woman who sells refreshments.
Two escaped convicts chained together, white and black, must learn to get along in order to elude capture.
Will Stockdale is a country bumpkin drafted into the Air Force and too dumb to realize he's driving everyone around him crazy, no one more than Sergeant King.
A prostitute, sentenced to death for murder, pleads her innocence.
Accused barn burner and conman Ben Quick (Paul Newman) arrives in a small Mississippi town and quickly ingratiates himself with its richest family, the Varners.
The stories of several people are told as they stay at a seaside hotel in Bournemouth which features dining at "Separate Tables."

Dave Hirsch, a writer and an army veteran winds up in his small Indiana hometown, to the dismay of his respectable older brother. He meets and befriends various different characters and tries to figure out what to do with his life.

Jonathan Harker begets the ire of Count Dracula after he accepts a job at the vampire's castle under false pretenses, forcing his colleague Dr. Van Helsing to destroy the predatory villain when he targets Harker's loved ones.

movies.t: The Inn of the Sixth Happiness
movies.s: A tenacious British woman becomes a missionary and runs an inn for travelling merchants in China during the Japanese invasion and the tumultuous years leading up to the Second World War.
A U.S. sub commander, obsessed with sinking a certain Japanese ship, butts heads with his first officer and crew.
Cassavetes' jazz-scored improvisational film explores interracial friendships and relationships in Beat-Era (1950s) New York City.
Saddled with a dull husband and a foolish lover, a woman has an affair with a stranger.
When a princess is shrunken by an evil wizard, Sinbad must undertake a quest to an island of monsters to cure her and prevent a war.
A scientist has a horrific accident when he tries to use his newly invented teleportation device.
A somewhat vulgar but dedicated painter searches for the perfect realization of his artistic vision, much to the chagrin of others.
A reformed outlaw becomes stranded after an aborted train robbery with two other passengers and is forced to rejoin his old outlaw band.
A hard-nosed newspaper editor poses as a night school student in order to woo a journalism teacher who cannot stand him.
A slave and a Viking prince fight for the love of a captive princess.
A man is chasing four outlaws who killed his wife and finds them in a small town's jail, but they escape to Mexico.
A rebellious young man takes a job as a nightclub singer to make ends meet, attracting the attention of a local crime boss.

movies.t: The Old Man and the Sea
movies.s: An old Cuban fisherman's dry spell is broken when he hooks a gigantic fish that drags him out to sea. Based on Ernest Hemingway's story.
A modern-day witch likes her neighbor but despises his fiancée, so she enchants him to love her instead, only to fall in love with him for real.
Cecile, decadent young girl who lives with her rich playboy father Raymond. When Anne, Raymond's old love interest, comes to Raymond's villa, Cecile is afraid for her way of life.
Baron Frankenstein escapes from the guillotine and goes to Germany. There, he names himself Dr. Stein and plans to restart his experiments by using parts of dead bodies.
An actress who has given up on love meets a suave banker and begins a flirtation with him...even though he's already married.
On a South Pacific island during World War II, love blooms between a young nurse and a secretive Frenchman who's being courted for a dangerous military mission.
Weary of the conventions of Parisian society, a rich playboy and a youthful courtesan-in-training enjoy a platonic friendship, but it may not stay platonic for long.
After his employer is murdered by rival cattlemen, a troubled and uneducated young cowboy vows revenge on the murderers.

movies.dir: Irvin S. Yeaworth Jr., Russell S. Doughten Jr.
movies.s: An alien lifeform consumes everything in its path as it grows and grows.
Invisible atomic monsters attack a U.S. Armed Forces base and the local residents.

movies.t: It! The Terror from Beyond Space
movies.s: The first manned expedition to Mars is decimated by an unknown life form which stows away on the rescue ship.
When an abused socialite grows to giant size because of an alien encounter and an aborted murder attempt, she goes after her cheating husband with revenge on her mind.
A series of decapitations on a Swiss mountainside appear to be connected to a mysterious radioactive cloud.
Balarama promises Subhadra to get his daughter married to her son. But when the Pandavas loses their kingdom to the Kaurava's, Balarama breaks his promise.
A jury holdout attempts to prevent a miscarriage of justice by forcing his colleagues to reconsider the evidence.
A talented but indigent poet Vijay struggles for love and recognition in this selfish world.
After refusing to attack an enemy position, a general accuses the soldiers of cowardice and their commanding officer must defend them.
A veteran British barrister must defend his client in a murder trial that has surprise after surprise.
Veronica plans a rendezvous with her lover, Boris, at the bank of river, only for him to be drafted into World War II shortly thereafter.
An Arkansas drifter becomes an overnight media sensation. As he becomes drunk with fame and power, will he ever be exposed as the fraud he has become?
A man seeks answers about life, death, and the existence of God as he plays chess against the Grim Reaper during the Black Plague.
After living a life marked by coldness, an aging professor is forced to confront the emptiness of his existence.
In this melodrama, a poverty-stricken woman raises her sons through many trials and tribulations. But no matter the struggles, always sticks to her own moral code.

movies.t: The Bridge on the River Kwai
movies.s: British POWs are forced to build a railway bridge across the river Kwai for their Japanese captors, not knowing that the allied forces are planning to destroy it.
A war-hardened general, egged on by his ambitious wife, works to fulfill a prophecy that he would become lord of Spider's Web Castle.
A waifish prostitute wanders the streets of Rome looking for true love but finds only heartbreak.
Powerful but unethical Broadway columnist J.J. Hunsecker coerces unscrupulous press agent Sidney Falco into breaking up his sister's romance with a jazz musician.
Two sisters find out the existence of their long-lost mother, but the younger cannot take the truth of being abandoned as a child.
In 1944, during the Warsaw uprising against the Nazis, Polish Lieutenant Zadra and his resistance fighters use Warsaw's sewer system to escape the German encirclement.
Broke small-time rancher Dan Evans is hired by the stagecoach line to put big-time captured outlaw leader Ben Wade on the 3:10 train to Yuma but Wade's gang tries to free him.
A man wanders aimlessly, away from his town, away from the woman he loved, emotionally and socially inactive.
When Scott Carey begins to shrink because of exposure to a combination of radiation and insecticide, medical science is powerless to help him.
A couple falls in love and agrees to meet in six months at the Empire State Building - but will it happen?
During World War II, an American destroyer meets a German U-Boat. Both captains are experts, and so begins a deadly game of cat-and-mouse.
American professor John Holden arrives in London for a parapsychology conference, only to find himself investigating the mysterious actions of Devil-worshiper Julian Karswell.

In a Japanese slum, various residents play out their lives, dreaming of better things or settling for their lot. Among them is a man who pines for a young woman but is stymied by her deceptive family.
During World War II, an American marine and an Irish nun form an unlikely friendship after being stranded on a South Pacific island. They find comfort in one another as the two hope for a rescue.

A teenage boy grows to love a stray yellow dog while helping his mother and younger brother run their Texas homestead while their father is away on a cattle drive. First thought to be good-for-nothing mutt, Old Yeller is soon beloved by all.
An independent former ranch foreman is kidnapped along with an heiress, who is being held for ransom by trio of ruthless outlaws.
A cynical former sheriff turned bounty hunter helps a young, recently appointed acting sheriff with his advice, his experience and his gun.
Lawman Wyatt Earp and outlaw Doc Holliday form an unlikely alliance which culminates in their participation in the legendary Gunfight at the O.K. Corral.
A middle-aged playboy becomes fascinated by the daughter of a private detective who has been hired to entrap him with the wife of a client.
A peaceful New England town hides secrets and scandals.
Victor Frankenstein builds a creature and brings it to life, but it behaves not as he intended.
A US Air Force major in Kobe confronts his own opposition to marriages between American servicemen and Japanese women when he falls for a beautiful performer.
Showdown in Arizona between the Bonnell brothers, U.S.Marshals, and Jessica Drummond, the iron-fist rancher who controls the territory.
An impromptu fashion shoot at a book store brings about a new fashion model discovery in the shop clerk.
To save his career, a writer for television advertising wants a famous actress to endorse a lipstick. In return, he has to pretend to be her new lover.
Professor Quatermass, trying to gather support for his Lunar colonisation project, is intrigued by mysterious traces that have been showing up.
A sportswriter and a fashion-designer marry after a whirlwind romance, and discover they have little in common.
A musical remake of Ninotchka: After three bumbling Soviet agents fail in their mission to retrieve a straying Soviet composer from Paris, the beautiful, ultra-serious Ninotchka is sent to ...
A fired railroad man is re-hired and trusted to carry a ten thousand dollar payroll in secret, even though he is suspected of being connected to outlaws.
An Iowa pajama factory worker falls in love with an affable superintendent who had been hired by the factory's boss to help oppose the workers' demand for a pay raise.

Joey Evans' a charming, handsome, funny, talented a-1st class, A-N°.1 - heel. When Joey meets the former chorus girl and now is the rich widow, Vera Simpson, the pair of lecherous souls seem made for each other.
A biography of Navy flier-turned-screenwriter Frank W. "Spig" Wead.
The final film in a highly romanticized trilogy about Elisabeth "Sissi" of Austria finds the young empress traveling throughout Europe.
After serving time for manslaughter, young Vince Everett becomes a teenage rock star.

movies.a: A 30 milioni di Km dalla Terra
movies.s: The first U.S. spaceship to Venus crash-lands off the coast of Sicily on its return trip. A dangerous, lizard-like creature comes with it and quickly grows gigantic.
A kindly English botanist and a gruff American scientist lead an expedition to the Himalayas in search of the legendary Yeti.
A student falls in love with a Southern belle, but their relationship is complicated by her troubled past and the on-set of the Civil War.
A giant prehistoric praying mantis, recently freed from the Arctic ice, voraciously preys on American military at the DEW Line and works its way south.
Global panic ensues when it is revealed that a mysterious UFO is actually a giant bird that flies at supersonic speed and has no regard for life or architecture.
Evil aliens attack Earth and set their terrible "Plan 9" into action. As the aliens resurrect the dead of the Earth, the lives of the living are in danger.
Following his father's death, a boy leaves home to study in Calcutta, while his mother must face a life alone.

movies.t: Un condamné à mort s'est échappé ou Le vent souffle où il veut
movies.a: Un condannato a morte è fuggito
movies.s: A captured French Resistance fighter during WWII engineers a daunting escape from a Nazi prison in France.
In the War's closing days, when a conscience-driven Japanese soldier fails to get his countrymen to surrender to overwhelming force, he adopts the lifestyle of a Buddhist monk.
Crook Johnny Clay assembles a five man team to plan and execute a daring race-track robbery.
The personal tales of various prostitutes who occupy a brothel.
An American Civil War veteran embarks on a journey to rescue his niece from the Comanches.
Moses, an Egyptian Prince, learns of his true heritage as a Hebrew and his divine mission as the deliverer of his people.
After losing big, an aging gambler decides to assemble a team to rob a casino.
A small-town doctor learns that the population of his community is being replaced by emotionless alien duplicates.
A seriously ill schoolteacher becomes dependent on a "miracle" drug that begins to affect his sanity.
A starship crew goes to investigate the silence of a planet's colony only to find two survivors and a deadly secret that one of them has.
Sprawling epic covering the life of a Texas cattle rancher and his family and associates.
Musashi Miyamoto is challenged to a duel by a confident swordsman Sasaki Kojiro. He agrees to fight him in a year's time.
A housewife suspects that her seemingly perfect eight-year-old daughter is a heartless killer.
An ex-sportswriter is hired by a shady fight promoter to promote his latest find, an unknown but easily exploitable rising star from Argentina.

movies.t: The Man Who Knew Too Much
movies.s: An American physician and his wife take matters into their own hands after assassins planning to execute a foreign Prime Minister kidnap their son.
Alcoholic playboy Kyle Hadley marries the woman secretly loved by his poor but hard-working best friend, who in turn is pursued by Kyle's nymphomaniac sister.
In 1945, an American Infantry company sets up an artillery observation post, but tensions between Captain Cooney and Lieutenant Costa run high.
A steamy tale of two Southern rivals and a sensuous nineteen-year-old virgin.
A widow accepts a job as a live-in governess to the King of Siam's children.
The life of brilliant but tortured artist

movies.a: L'uomo che non è mai esistito
movies.s: True story of a British attempt to trick the enemy into weakening Sicily's defenses before the 1943 attack, using a dead man with faked papers.
A former sheriff blames himself for his wife's death during a Wells Fargo robbery and vows to track down and kill the seven men responsible.

Two men carry at night four suitcases of contraband meat across German-occupied Paris during WWII. Their opposite personalities and strange encounters provoke different adventures - until they are arrested by the police.
In 1953, an innocent man named Christopher Emmanuel "Manny" Balestrero is arrested after being mistaken for an armed robber.
The pacifist attitude of a Quaker family is tested as a result of the American Civil War.
The sole survivor of a lost whaling ship relates the tale of his captain's self-destructive obsession to hunt the white whale, Moby Dick.
Through a series of bizarre coincidences, an artist finds himself falsely accused of bank robbery and murder and is pursued by the authorities and the real killers.
A new foreman rejects the sexual advances of a frustrated rancher's wife, which leads to conflicts that could get him killed.

movies.t: The Man in the Gray Flannel Suit
movies.s: An ex-soldier faces ethical questions as he tries to earn enough to support his wife and children well.
In a totalitarian future society, Winston Smith, whose daily work is re-writing history, tries to rebel by falling in love.
A novelist aided by his future father-in-law conspires to frame himself for the murder of a burlesque dancer as part of an effort to ban capital punishment.
A spoiled heiress must choose among three suitors: her jazz musician ex-husband, a stuffy businessman, and an undercover tabloid reporter.
During the Depression, a con-man promises rain to a desperate drought-ridden Kansas town and marriage to a local desperate spinster.

A serial killer has been killing beautiful women in New York and the new owner of a media company offers a high ranking job to the first of his senior executives who can get the earliest scoops on the case.
A crippled circus acrobat is torn emotionally between two ambitious young trapeze artists, one a talented young American and a less-gifted but beautiful Italian.

movies.a: Il giro del mondo in 80 giorni
movies.s: A Victorian Englishman bets that with the new steamships and railways he can circumnavigate the globe in eighty days.

movies.t: The Teahouse of the August Moon
movies.a: La casa da tè alla luna d'agosto
movies.s: In post-WWII Japan, an American captain is brought in to help build a school, but the locals want a teahouse instead.
Napoleon's (Herbert Lom's) tumultuous relations with Russia including his disastrous 1812 invasion serve as the backdrop for the tangled personal lives of two aristocratic families.
A ruthless college student resorts to murder in an attempt to marry an heiress.

The second in a trilogy of movies about Elisabeth "Sissi" of Austria, the film chronicles the married life of the young empress as she tries to adjust to formal and strict life in the palace and an overbearing mother-in-law.

movies.t: The Battle of the River Plate
movies.a: La battaglia di Rio della Plata
movies.s: In the first major naval battle of World War II, the British Navy must find and destroy a powerful German warship.
Fifteen years after his death, a carousel barker is granted permission to return to Earth for one day to make amends to his widow and their daughter.
A 400-foot (122-meter) dinosaur-like beast, awoken from undersea hibernation off the Japanese coast by atomic-bomb testing, attacks Tokyo.
A naive but stubborn cowboy falls in love with a saloon singer and tries to take her away against her will to get married and live on his ranch in Montana.

movies.a: La Terra contro i dischi volanti
movies.s: Extraterrestrials traveling in high-tech flying saucers contact a scientist as part of a plan to enslave the inhabitants of Earth.
A large mining accident sets loose prehistoric Insects and giant pterosaur's on Japan.
At the end of the Civil War, a Confederate team is ordered to rob a Union payroll train but the war ends leaving these men with their Union loot, until the Feds come looking for it.
The life and military conquests of Alexander III of Macedon (July 20/21, 356 - June 10/11, 323 B.C.), commonly known as Alexander the Great.
A scientist captures the Creature and turns him into an air-breather, only for him to escape and start killing.
A party of archaeologists discovers the remnants of a mutant five-millennia-old Sumerian civilization living beneath a glacier atop a mountain in Mesopotamia.
Impoverished priest Harihar Ray, dreaming of a better life for himself and his family, leaves his rural Bengal village in search of work.
Follows the lives of the Borgen family, as they deal with inner conflict, as well as religious conflict with each other, and the rest of the town.
Four men plan a technically perfect crime, but the human element intervenes...
The wife and mistress of a loathed school principal plan to murder him with what they believe is the perfect alibi.
A religious fanatic marries a gullible widow whose young children are reluctant to tell him where their real daddy hid the $10,000 he'd stolen in a robbery.
The tale of a platoon of soldiers during the Continuation War. Based on Väinö Linna's book of the same name.
A wilful young man contends against his brother for the attention of their religious father while reconnecting with his estranged mother and falling for his brother's girlfriend.
A hapless carnival performer masquerades as the court jester as part of a plot against an evil ruler who has overthrown the rightful King.
The delirious journey of a mental disordered man, who is obsessed in making the perfect crime.
In Sweden at the turn of the century, members of the upper class and their servants find themselves in a romantic tangle that they try to work out amidst jealousy and heartbreak.
A one-armed stranger comes to a tiny town possessing a terrible past they want to keep secret, by violent means if necessary.
Five oddball criminals planning a bank robbery rent rooms on a cul-de-sac from an octogenarian widow under the pretext that they are classical musicians.
A middle-aged butcher and a school teacher who have given up on the idea of love meet at a dance and fall for each other.

movies.a: La nave matta di Mister Roberts
movies.s: In the waning days of World War II, the United States Navy cargo ship Reluctant and her crew are stationed in the "backwater" areas of the Pacific Ocean. Trouble ensues when the crew members are granted liberty.
A couple having an affair strike a bicyclist with their car and do not offer aid out of fear of their relationship being exposed.
A rebellious young man with a troubled past comes to a new town, finding friends and enemies.
An upper-class widow falls in love with a much younger, down-to-earth nurseryman, much to the disapproval of her children and criticism of her country club peers.
A doomed female hitchhiker pulls Mike Hammer into a deadly whirlpool of intrigue, revolving around a mysterious "great whatsit".
A trio of con-men led by a lonesome swindler must deal with their job and family pressures.
Three escaped convicts move in on and terrorize a suburban household.
Three Devil's Island escapees hide out in the house of a kindly merchant and repay his kindness by helping him and his family out of several crises.
The story of how the British attacked German dams in World War II by using an ingenious technique to drop bombs where they would be most effective.

A police lt. is ordered to stop investigating deadly crime boss Mr. Brown, because he hasn't been able to get any hard evidence against him. He then goes after Brown's girlfriend who despises him, for information instead.
A new English teacher at a violent, unruly inner-city school is determined to do his job, despite resistance from both students and faculty.

movies.t: The Man with the Golden Arm
movies.s: A strung-out junkie deals with a demoralizing drug addiction while his crippled wife and card sharks pull him down.

movies.t: Zoku Miyamoto Musashi: Ichijôji no kettô
movies.s: Musashi Miyamoto returns to Kyoto after years of absence. After a series of fights against the Yoshioka School, he challenges its master to a duel.
A retired jewel thief sets out to prove his innocence after being suspected of returning to his former occupation.
Shakespeare's powerful tale of the wicked deformed King and his conquests, both on the battlefield and in the boudoir.
This comedy drama from Jean Renoir chronicles the revival of Paris' most notorious dance as it tells the story of a theater producer who turns a humble washerwoman into a star at the Moulin Rouge.
An aging Japanese industrialist becomes so fearful of nuclear war that it begins to take a toll on his life and family.
The romantic tale of a sheltered uptown Cocker Spaniel dog and a streetwise downtown Mutt.
When she is reduced to appearing in a circus, a notorious beauty thinks back on her past loves.
Newcomer Will Lockhart defies the local cattle baron and his sadistic son by working for one of his oldest rivals.
In New York, a gambler is challenged to take a cold female missionary to Havana, but they fall for each other, and the bet has a hidden motive to finance a crap game.
The true WWII story of Audie Murphy, the most decorated soldier in U.S. history. Based on the autobiography of Audie Murphy who stars as himself in the film.
A fictionalized account of the career of jazz singer
Emotions are ignited amongst the complacent townsfolk when a handsome drifter arrives in a small Kansas community on the morning of the Labour Day picnic.

movies.a: Quando la moglie è in vacanza
movies.s: When his family goes away for the summer, a hitherto faithful husband with an overactive imagination is tempted by a beautiful neighbor.
The trouble with Harry is that he's dead, and everyone seems to have a different idea of what should be done with his body.

movies.t: Davy Crockett: King of the Wild Frontier
movies.s: American frontiersman Davy Crockett fights in the Creek Indian War, is elected to the U.S. Congress and fights for Texas at the Alamo.
In Oklahoma, several farmers, cowboys and a traveling salesman compete for the romantic favors of various local ladies.
An Italian-American neighborhood in Louisiana is disturbed when truck driver Rosario Delle Rose is killed by police while smuggling. His buxom widow Serafina miscarries, then over a period ...
In the first of a trilogy of movies about Elisabeth "Sissi" of Austria, the young vibrant princess catches the eye of her sister's fiancé, Emperor Franz Josef.
Hollywood actor Charles Castle is pressured by his studio boss into a criminal cover-up to protect his valuable career.

A wealthy American has a chance encounter with a joyful young French woman, and anonymously pays for her education. She writes letters to her mysterious benefactor, nicknaming him from the description given by some of her fellow orphans.

A young orphan is sent to the village of Moonfleet, in Dorset, England to stay with his mother's former lover, who has the facade of a gentleman but is a leader of a gang of swashbuckling bootleggers. The duo went on a treasure hunt.
Professor Bernard Quatermass' manned rocket ship returns to Earth, but two of the astronauts are missing and the survivor seems ill and unable to communicate.
Rick Todd uses the dreams of his roommate Eugene as the basis for a successful comic book.
Ready to catch a train to his hometown, a washed-up boxer tells us about the strange and twisty events that happened to him the past couple of days.
A captured architect designs an ingenious plan to ensure the impregnability of the tomb of a self-absorbed Pharaoh, obsessed with the security of his next life.
A widowed doctor of both Chinese and European descent falls in love with a married American correspondent in Hong Kong during China's Communist revolution.
A spider escapes from an isolated Arizona desert laboratory experimenting in giantism and grows to tremendous size as it wreaks havoc on the local inhabitants.

movies.t: Abbott and Costello Meet the Mummy
movies.s: Bud and Lou find themselves pursued by an Egyptian cult for a special medallion linked to a walking mummy.
An ex-pilot and current baseballer is recalled into the U.S. Air Force and assumes an increasingly important role in Cold War deterrence.

movies.t: It Came from Beneath the Sea
movies.s: A giant, radioactive octopus rises from the Philippine Trench to terrorize the North American Pacific Coast.
Aliens come to Earth seeking scientists to help them in their war.
Godzilla battles an irradiated Ankylosaur and destroys Osaka in the process.
Men capture the Creature from the Black Lagoon and make him an aquarium attraction, from which he escapes.
A mad doctor attempts to create atomic supermen.
A poor village under attack by bandits recruits seven unemployed samurai to help them defend themselves.
A wheelchair-bound photographer spies on his neighbors from his apartment window and becomes convinced one of them has committed murder.
In medieval Japan, a compassionate governor is sent into exile. His wife and children try to join him, but are separated, and the children grow up amid suffering and oppression.
A tennis player tries to arrange his wife's murder after learning of her affair.
An ex-prize fighter turned longshoreman struggles to stand up to his corrupt union bosses.

Ishun is a wealthy, but unsympathetic, master printer who has wrongly accused his wife and best employee of being lovers. To escape punishment, the accused run away together, but Ishun is certain to be ruined if word gets out.
A care-free girl is sold to a traveling entertainer, consequently enduring physical and emotional pain along the way.
An aging, world-weary gangster is double-crossed and forced out of retirement when his best friend is kidnapped and their stash of eight stolen gold bars demanded as ransom.
When a U.S. Naval captain shows signs of mental instability that jeopardizes the ship, the first officer relieves him of command and faces court martial for mutiny.

Henry Hobson (Charles Laughton) is a successful bootmaker, a widower and a tyrannical father of three daughters. The girls each want to leave their father by getting married, but Henry refuses because marriage traditions require him to pay out settlements.
After helping a wounded gang member, a strong-willed female saloon owner is wrongly suspected of murder and bank robbery by a lynch mob.
A playboy becomes interested in the daughter of his family's chauffeur, but it's his more serious brother who would be the better man for her.
American nuclear weapons testing results in the creation of a seemingly unstoppable, dinosaur-like beast.
A film star helps a young singer and actress find fame, even as age and alcoholism send his own career on a downward spiral.
A successful song-and-dance team become romantically involved with a sister act and team up to save the failing Vermont inn of their former commanding general.

When a young girl is found dead an inspector is sent to investigate a prosperous Yorkshire household. It emerges that each member of the family has a guilty secret - each one is partly responsible for her death.
An Italian Countess is allied with Nationalists during the Italian-Austrian war of unification. However, she risks betraying their cause when she falls in love with an Austrian Lieutenant.
An unhappily married couple attempts to find direction and insight while vacationing in Naples.
When the head of a large manufacturing firm dies suddenly from a stroke, his vice presidents vie to see who will replace him.

Mexican workers at a Zinc mine call a general strike. It is only through the solidarity of the workers, and importantly the indomitable resolve of their wives, mothers and daughters, that they eventually triumph.
In 1850 Oregon, when a backwoodsman brings a wife home to his farm, his six brothers decide that they want to get married too.
A director hires an alcoholic has-been and strikes up a stormy relationship with the actor's wife, who he believes is the cause of all the man's problems.
Biography of bandleader
A ship sent to investigate a wave of mysterious sinkings encounters the advanced submarine, the Nautilus, commanded by Captain Nemo.
When a young woman with dreams of fame rents a billboard to advertise herself, her life changes overnight.
The earliest atomic tests in New Mexico cause common ants to mutate into giant man-eating monsters that threaten civilization.
A successful farmyard revolution by the resident animals vs. the farmer goes horribly wrong as the victors create a new tyranny among themselves.
A self-minded adventurer (Jeff Webster) locks horns with a crooked lawman (Mr. Gannon) while driving cattle to Dawson.
A Korean War vet returns to his job as a railroad engineer and becomes involved in an affair with a co-worker's wife following a murder on a train where they meet.
Nicky and Tacy are going to be married. Nicky wants to save up money for a house, but Tacy dreams of starting off with their own home on wheels--a trailer.
A rich playboy whose recklessness inadvertently causes the death of a prominent doctor tries to make amends to his widow, and falls for her in the process.
During the Mexican Rebellion of 1866, an unsavory group of American adventurers are hired by the forces of Emporer Maximilian to escort a countess to Vera Cruz.
This is the life of a Hollywood movie star named Maria, as told by writer/director Harry et al, from being discovered in Madrid, Spain, until her funeral in Italy.
A strange prehistoric beast lurks in the depths of the Amazonian jungle. A group of scientists try to capture the animal and bring it back to civilization for study.
As part of a bet, two aristocrats offer a penniless American a loan, without telling him that the amount is £1,000,000 in the form of a single banknote.
The saga of the Devereaux rancher family, set in 1880's Arizona.
The classic story of Robinson Crusoe, a man who is dragged to a desert island after a shipwreck.
Contemporary version of the Bizet opera, with new lyrics and an African-American cast.
When a commercial airliner develops engine problems on a trans-Pacific flight and the pilot loses his nerve, it is up to the washed-up co-pilot Dan Roman to bring the plane in safely.
The Leiningen South American cocoa plantation is threatened by a 2-mile-wide, 20-mile-long column of army ants.
In the city of Suddenly, three gangsters trap the Benson family in their own house, on the top of a hill nearby the railroad station, with the intention of killing the president of the USA.

Set during the Korean War, a Navy fighter pilot must come to terms with with his own ambivalence towards the war and the fear of having to bomb a set of highly defended bridges. The ending of this grim war drama is all tension.
A movie adaptation of Homer's second epic, that talks about Ulysses' efforts to return to his home after the end of ten years of war.
In 1st century Rome, Christian slave Demetrius is sent to fight in the gladiatorial arena and Emperor Caligula seeks Jesus' robe for its supposedly magical powers.
In ancient Egypt, a poor orphan becomes a genial physician and is eventually appointed at the Pharaoh's court where he witnesses palace intrigues and learns dangerous royal secrets.

The titular river unites a farmer recently released from prison, his young son, and an ambitious saloon singer. In order to survive, each must be purged of anger, and each must learn to understand and care for the others.

movies.t: There's No Business Like Show Business
movies.s: Molly and Terry Donahue, plus their three children, are The Five Donahues. Son Tim meets hat-check girl Vicky and the family act begins to fall apart.
Refusing to let himself be re-settled on a Florida reservation, Massai, an Apache warrior, escapes his captors and returns to his homeland to become a peaceful farmer.
Three American women working in Rome, Italy, share a spacious apartment and the desire to find love and marriage, each experiencing a few bumps in their journeys to romance.

movies.t: The Last Time I Saw Paris
movies.s: Charles Wills returns to Paris to reminisce about the life he led there after it was liberated. He worked then for "Stars and Stripes" when he met both Marion and Helen Ellswirth. He soon ...

movies.a: I racconti della luna pallida di agosto
movies.s: A tale of ambition, family, love, and war set in the midst of the Japanese Civil Wars of the sixteenth century.
An old couple visit their children and grandchildren in the city, but receive little attention.
In a decrepit South American village, four men are hired to transport an urgent nitroglycerine shipment without the equipment that would make it safe.
A husband's suave exterior unravels after his marriage, and he unleashes his paranoid and volatile temper on his wife, which escalates to more dangerous and unpredictable tantrums.
After finding out that North American people are visiting the Spanish villages, the citizens of Villar del Río start preparing themselves to welcome them when they arrive.
Tough cop Dave Bannion takes on a politically powerful crime syndicate.

When an aristocratic woman known only as "Madame de . . ." sells a pair of earrings given to her by her husband in order to pay some debts, she sets off a chain reaction of financial and carnal consequences that can end only in despair.
A bored and sheltered princess escapes her guardians and falls in love with an American newsman in Rome.
When two escaping American World War II prisoners are killed, the German P.O.W. camp barracks black marketeer, J.J. Sefton, is suspected of being an informer.
A character study of five young men at crucial turning points in their lives in a small town in Italy.
A pickpocket unwittingly lifts a message destined for enemy agents and becomes a target for a Communist spy ring.
In Hawaii in 1941, a private is cruelly punished for not boxing on his unit's team, while his captain's wife and second-in-command are falling in love.
The complicated relationships between a circus ringmaster, his estranged wife and his lover.
A weary gunfighter attempts to settle down with a homestead family, but a smoldering settler/rancher conflict forces him to act.
A pretentiously artistic director is hired for a new Broadway musical and changes it beyond recognition.
The World War II adventures of a British convoy escort ship and its officers.
A pair of teenagers meet one summer day, start a reckless affair and abandon their families to be with one another.
Monsieur Hulot comes to a beachside hotel for a vacation and accidentally, but good-naturedly, causes havoc.
A bounty hunter trying to bring a murderer to justice is forced to accept the help of two less-than-trustworthy strangers.
An orphaned young woman becomes part of a puppet act and forms a relationship with the anti-social puppeteer.
Reformed parolee Steve Lacey is caught in the middle when a wounded former cellmate seeks him out for shelter.
Ambulance driver Frank Jessup is ensnared in the schemes of the sensuous but dangerous Diane Tremayne.
The story of Calamity Jane, her saloon, and her romance with Wild Bill Hickok.
A priest, who comes under suspicion for murder, cannot clear his name without breaking the seal of the confessional.

The growing ambition of Julius Caesar is a source of major concern to his close friend Brutus. Cassius persuades him to participate in his plot to assassinate Caesar but they have both sorely underestimated Mark Antony.
Wendy and her brothers are whisked away to the magical world of Neverland with the hero of their stories, Peter Pan.

Showgirls Lorelei Lee and Dorothy Shaw travel to Paris, pursued by a private detective hired by the suspicious father of Lorelei's fiancé, as well as a rich, enamored old man and many other doting admirers.
A samurai pursues a married lady-in-waiting.
Army dispatch rider Hondo Lane discovers a woman and young son living in the midst of warring Apaches and becomes their protector.
An associate burns down a wax museum with the owner inside, but he survives only to become vengeful and murderous.

An ex-husband and wife team star in a musical version of 'The Taming of the Shrew'; off-stage, the production is troublesome with ex-lovers' quarrels and two gangsters looking for some money owed to them.
A small town in California is attacked by Martians, beginning a worldwide invasion.
As two couples are visiting Niagara Falls, tensions between one wife and her husband reach the level of murder.
An unhappily married couple struggle to deal with their problems while on board the ill-fated ship.
A telephone operator ends up drunk and at the mercy of a cad in his apartment. The next morning she wakes up with a hangover and the terrible fear she may be a murderess.
Three women set out to find eligible millionaires to marry, but find true love in the process.

A C-47 transport plane, named the Corsair, makes a forced landing in the frozen wastes of Quebec, and the plane's pilot, Captain Dooley, must keep his men alive in deadly conditions while waiting for rescue.

A young boy dreams that he is in an imaginary world where, assisted by his family's plumber, he must save other piano-playing kids like himself from the dungeons of his dictatorial piano teacher who also mind-controls his mother.
Richard Burton plays a Scottish Army officer put in charge of a disparate band of ANZAC troops on the perimeter of Tobruk with the German Army doing their best to dislodge them.
Two rival motorcycle gangs terrorize a small town after one of their leaders is thrown in jail.
A ferocious dinosaur awakened by an Arctic atomic test terrorizes the North Atlantic and, ultimately, New York City.
In the Roman province of Judea during the 1st century, Roman tribune Marcellus Gallio is ordered to crucify Jesus of Nazareth but is tormented by his guilty conscience afterwards.

movies.t: Abbott and Costello Meet Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
movies.a: Gianni e Pinotto contro il dottor Jekyll
movies.s: Two bumbling American cops hunt for the mysterious Mr. Hyde in London, England.
A spaceship from another world crashes in the Arizona desert and only an amateur stargazer and a schoolteacher suspect alien influence when the local townsfolk begin to act strangely.
On their way to Africa are a group of rogues who hope to get rich there, and a seemingly innocent British couple. They meet and things happen...
King Arthur's rule is threatened by the adulterous love between Sir Lancelot and Queen Guinevere, a relationship the king's enemies hope to exploit.

movies.t: Abbott and Costello Go to Mars
movies.s: Two workmen accidentally launch a space rocket intended for Mars, and find mistakenly landing in New Orleans just the beginning of their misadventures.
Four soldiers trapped behind enemy lines must confront their fears and desires.
A psychiatrist tells the stories of a transvestite (Glen or Glenda) and a pseudohermaphrodite (Alan or Anne).
The monstrous Ro-Man attempts to annihilate the last family alive on Earth, but finds himself falling for their beautiful daughter.
A bureaucrat tries to find a meaning in his life after he discovers he has terminal cancer.
A silent film production company and cast make a difficult transition to sound.
Follows a woman's fight and survival amid the vicissitudes of life and the cruelty of the society.
An elderly man and his dog struggle to survive on his government pension in Rome.
A fading comedian and a suicidally despondent ballet dancer must look to each other to find purpose and hope in their lives.
A young French girl orphaned in a Nazi air attack is befriended by the son of a poor farmer, and together they try to come to terms with the realities of death.

A town Marshal, despite the disagreements of his newlywed bride and the townspeople around him, must face a gang of deadly killers alone at high noon when the gang leader, an outlaw he sent up years ago, arrives on the noon train.
An unscrupulous movie producer uses an actress, a director and a writer to achieve success.
Three gangsters and an ex-con carpenter all fall for the same beautiful, golden-haired woman in Belle Époque France.
A determined priest and a Communist mayor develop a grudging friendship in spite of their official rivalry.
During WWII the valet to the British Ambassador to Ankara sells British secrets to the Germans while trying to romance a refugee Polish countess.
A woman planning to testify against the mob must be protected against their assassins on the train trip from Chicago to Los Angeles.
Three separate stories about the same thing: le plaisir (pleasure).
A retired American boxer returns to the village of his birth in Ireland, where he falls for a spirited redhead whose brother is contemptuous of their union.
A wealthy woman becomes obsessed with humanitarianism when her young son dies after committing suicide.
An emotionally remote recovering alcoholic and his dowdy, unambitious wife face a personal crisis when they take in an attractive lodger.

When Algernon discovers that his friend, Ernest, has created a fictional brother for whenever he needs a reason to escape dull country life, Algernon poses as the brother, resulting in ever increasing confusion.
In France during the late 18th Century, a man sets out to avenge the death of his friend at the hands of a master swordsman.
After an ambitious actor insinuates himself into the life of a wealthy middle-aged playwright and marries her, he plots with his mistress to murder her.
An ex-con trying to go straight is framed for a million dollar armored car robbery and must go to Mexico in order to unmask the real culprits.
The story of Mexican revolutionary
When a town boss confiscates homesteader's supplies after gold is discovered nearby, a tough cowboy risks his life to try and get it to them.

During the 1700s, pirate Captain Vallo seizes a British warship and gets involved in various money-making schemes involving Caribbean rebels led by El Libre, British envoy Baron Jose Gruda, and a beautiful courtesan named Consuelo.
During a day in their honeymoon, a couple is separated by the city's lust and the desires it produces.

Mae Doyle comes back to her hometown a cynical woman. Her brother Joe fears that his love, fish cannery worker Peggy, may wind up like Mae. Mae marries Jerry and has a baby; she is happy but restless, drawn to Jerry's friend Earl.
Fictional account of French artist Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec.
The success of the journey focuses on keeping the Indian girl alive as well as themselves to complete trade with the Blackfeet.
A chemist finds his personal and professional life turned upside down when one of his chimpanzees finds the fountain of youth.
Pat is a women's sports sensation unless her fiancé is around. Her new shady manager Mike keeps them apart and develops feelings for her.
An Englishman vacationing in a Ruritarian kingdom is recruited to impersonate his cousin, the soon-to-be-crowned king after the monarch is drugged and kidnapped.
After the murder of his fiancée, a Wyoming ranch hand sets out to find her killer.
A washed-up movie queen finds romance, but still desires a comeback.
After being dumped by his girlfriend, an airline pilot pursues a babysitter in his hotel and gradually realizes she's dangerous.

The opening scene of the movie describes it best: "Once upon a time there lived in Denmark a great storyteller named Hans Christian Andersen. This is not the story of his life, but a fairy tale about the great spinner of fairy tales."
A knight seeks to free the captive King Richard (Norman Wooland) and put him back on the throne.

movies.a: Il più grande spettacolo del mondo
movies.s: The dramatic lives of trapeze artists, a clown, and an elephant trainer are told against a background of circus spectacle.
Two unemployed show-biz pals accept treasure-diving work in Bali for a local princess and they find treasure, love and trouble.
Writer Harry Street reflects on his life as he lies dying from an infection while on safari in the shadow of Mount Kilamanjaro.
Forced to retire from an English public school, an unpopular professor must confront his failure as a teacher and husband.

A frustrated former big-city journalist now stuck working for an Albuquerque newspaper exploits a story about a man trapped in a cave to rekindle his career, but the situation quickly escalates into an out-of-control circus.

Ebenezer Scrooge, a curmudgeonly, miserly businessman, has no time for sentimentality and largely views Christmas as a waste of time. However, this Christmas Eve he will be visited by three spirits who will show him the errors of his ways.

movies.a: Un tram che si chiama Desiderio
movies.s: Disturbed Blanche DuBois moves in with her sister in New Orleans and is tormented by her brutish brother-in-law while her reality crumbles around her.

movies.a: Il diario di un curato di campagna
movies.s: A young priest taking over the parish at Ambricourt tries to fulfill his duties even as he fights a mysterious stomach ailment.
A poor young man named Raj joins a criminal gang to feed his mother. But when he falls in love with Rita, he decides to reform himself for her.
A psychopath forces a tennis star to comply with his theory that two strangers can get away with murder.
A woman from the lower class desperately tries to get her daughter into the movies.
A poor boy gets a job working for his rich uncle and ends up falling in love with two women.
In WWI Africa, a gin-swilling riverboat captain is persuaded by a strait-laced missionary to use his boat to attack an enemy warship.

movies.t: The Day the Earth Stood Still
movies.s: An alien lands and tells the people of Earth that they must live peacefully or be destroyed as a danger to other planets.
An open hearted and unrelentingly energetic orphan struggles to make the best out of his life on the streets of Milan.
On one day in the 21st Precinct squad room, assorted characters form a backdrop for the troubles of hard-nosed Detective Jim McLeod.
A lonely woman recalls her first love thirteen years prior during a brief summer vacation.
A meek bank clerk who oversees the shipment of bullion joins with an eccentric neighbor to steal gold bars and smuggle them out of the country as miniature Eiffel Towers.
Three adolescent girls growing up in Bengal, India, learn their lessons in life after falling for an older American soldier.
Alice stumbles into the world of Wonderland. Will she get home? Not if the Queen of Hearts has her way.
Dr. Noah Praetorius falls in love with Debra, a student who finds out that she is pregnant by her old boyfriend.
A ragtag group of American stragglers battles against superior Communist troops in an abandoned Buddhist temple during the Korean War.

movies.a: Le avventure del capitano Hornblower (Il temerario)
movies.s: During the Napoleonic wars, a British Navy Captain has adventures in Central American waters.
A crusading district attorney finally gets a chance to prosecute the organizer and boss of Murder Inc.
A Japanese veteran, driven partially mad from the war, travels to the snowy island of Hokkaido where he soon enters a love triangle with his best friend and a disgraced woman.
Rough city cop Jim Wilson is disciplined by his captain and is sent upstate, to a snowy mountain town, to help the local sheriff solve a murder case.

movies.t: The Man in the White Suit
movies.s: An altruistic chemist invents a fabric which resists wear and stain as a boon to humanity, but big business and labor realize it must be suppressed for economic reasons.
Three friends struggle to find work in Paris. Things become more complicated when two of them fall in love with the same woman.
An aeronautical engineer predicts that a new model of plane will fail catastrophically and in a novel manner after a specific number flying hours.
Fierce Roman commander Marcus Vinicius becomes infatuated with beautiful Christian hostage Lygia and begins questioning the tyrannical leadership of the despot Emperor Nero.
Truncated adaptation of Stephen Crane's novel about a Civil War Union soldier who stuggles to find the courage to fight in the heat of battle.
A deported gangster's plan to re-enter the USA involves skulduggery at a Mexican resort, and gambler Dan Milner is caught in the middle.
Scientists and American Air Force officials fend off a bloodthirsty alien organism while at a remote arctic outpost.
A seductive woman falls in love with a mysterious ship's captain.

movies.t: The Desert Fox: The Story of Rommel
movies.s: The story of the final years of the respected World War II German general, Erwin Rommel.
The daughter of a riverboat captain falls in love with a charming gambler, but their fairytale romance is threatened when his luck turns sour.

movies.t: Bud Abbott Lou Costello Meet the Invisible Man
movies.a: Gianni e Pinotto contro l'uomo invisibile
movies.s: Two bumbling private eyes help a man wrongly accused of murder who has become invisible to help clear his name.
During WWII, a submarine's second in command inherits the problem of torpedoes that don't explode. When on shore, he is eager to win back his ex-wife.
A brother and sister dance act encounter challenges and romance when booked in London during the Royal Wedding.
Shortly after coming to terms with his daughter's marriage, a father faces the prospect of becoming a grandfather.
As a new star and planet hurtle toward a doomed Earth, a small group of survivalists frantically work to complete the rocket which will take them to their new home.
Major Kirby leads The Wildcats squadron into the historic WWII battle of Guadalcanal.
A screenwriter develops a dangerous relationship with a faded film star determined to make a triumphant return.
A group of juvenile delinquents live a violent and crime-filled life in the festering slums of Mexico City, and the morals of young Pedro are gradually corrupted and destroyed by the others.
A seemingly timid but secretly ruthless ingénue insinuates herself into the lives of an aging Broadway star and her circle of theater friends.
The rape of a bride and the murder of her samurai husband are recalled from the perspectives of a bandit, the bride, the samurai's ghost and a woodcutter.
A poet in love with Death follows his unhappy wife into the underworld.
A potentially violent screenwriter is a murder suspect until his lovely neighbor clears him. However, she soon starts to have her doubts.
A major heist goes off as planned, but then double crosses, bad luck and solid police work cause everything to unravel.
Due to his insistence that he has an invisible six foot-tall rabbit for a best friend, a whimsical middle-aged man is thought by his family to be insane - but he may be wiser than anyone knows.
A small-time grifter and nightclub tout takes advantage of some fortuitous circumstances and tries to become a big-time player as a wrestling promoter.
A naive nineteen year old widow becomes coarsened and cynical when she is sent to a woman's prison and is exposed to hardened criminals and sadistic guards.
Notorious gunfighter Jimmy Ringo rides into town to find his true love, who doesn't want to see him. He hasn't come looking for trouble, but trouble finds him around every corner.
A tycoon hires a tutor to teach his lover proper etiquette, with unexpected results.
A well meaning crack shot husband is pressured by his beautiful marksman wife to go on an interstate robbery spree, where he finds out just how depraved and deadly she really is.

movies.a: La ronde: Il piacere e l'amore
movies.s: Vignettes revolving around a circle of interconnected love.
The journey of a prized rifle from one ill-fated owner to another parallels a cowboy's search for a murderous fugitive.
The charismatic swordsman-poet helps another woo the woman he loves in this straightforward version of the play.
A series of vignettes depicting the lives of the original Franciscan monks, including their leader and the bumbling Ginepro.
A black doctor is assigned to treat two white racist suspects who are brothers, and when one dies, it causes tension that could start a race riot.
Karin, a young woman from the Baltic countries, marries fisherman Antonio to escape from a prison camp. But she cannot get used to the tough life in Antonio's volcano-threatened village, Stromboli.
When Cinderella's cruel stepmother prevents her from attending the Royal Ball, she gets some unexpected help from the lovable mice Gus and Jaq, and from her Fairy Godmother.
A doctor and a policeman in New Orleans have only 48 hours to locate a killer infected with pneumonic plague.
The father of a young woman deals with the emotional pain of her getting married, along with the financial and organizational trouble of arranging the wedding.
A celebrity photograph sparks a court case as a tabloid magazine spins a scandalous yarn over a painter and a famous singer.
A small-town farmer, down on her luck, finds her homestead invaded by a theatrical troupe invited to stay by her ne'er-do-well sister.
The dangerously obsessive relationship between a psychologically manipulative brother and sister who isolate themselves and draw others into their mind games.
A paralyzed war vet tries to adjust to the world without the use of his limbs.
A cavalry officer posted on the Rio Grande is confronted with murderous raiding Apaches, a son who's a risk-taking recruit and his wife from whom he has been separated for many years.
A struggling actress tries to help a friend prove his innocence when he's accused of murdering the husband of a high society entertainer.
Two young drifters guide a Mormon wagon train to the San Juan Valley and encounter cutthroats, Indians, geography, and moral challenges on the journey.
"Cheaper By the Dozen", based on the real-life story of the Gilbreth family, follows them from Providence, Rhode Island to Montclair, New Jersey, and details the amusing anecdotes found in ...
Dardo, a Robin Hood-like figure, and his loyal followers use a Roman ruin in Medieval Lombardy as their headquarters as they conduct an insurgency against their Hessian conquerors.
The story of the great sharpshooter
The treasure seeking adventures of young Jim Hawkins and pirate captain Long John Silver.

A woman suffering from kleptomania's hypnotised in an attempt to cure her.. Soon afterwards, she's found at the scene of a murder with no memory of how she got there, and seemingly no way to prove her innocence.
Adventurer Allan Quartermain leads an expedition into uncharted African territory in an attempt to locate an explorer who went missing during his search for the fabled diamond mines of King Solomon.
After their latest rocket fails, Dr. Charles Cargraves and retired General Thayer have to start over again. This time, Gen. Thayer approaches Jim Barnes, the head of his own aviation ...
Noriko is twenty-seven years old and still living with her widowed father. Everybody tries to talk her into marrying, but Noriko wants to stay at home caring for her father.
A young naive woman falls for a handsome young man who her emotionally abusive father suspects is a fortune hunter.
Pulp novelist Holly Martins travels to shadowy, postwar Vienna, only to find himself investigating the mysterious death of an old friend, Harry Lime.
A psychopathic criminal with a mother complex makes a daring break from prison and leads his old gang in a chemical plant payroll heist.
A distant poor relative of the Duke D'Ascoyne plots to inherit the title by murdering the eight other heirs who stand ahead of him in the line of succession.
During a sweltering summer, a rookie homicide detective tries to track down his stolen Colt pistol.

Because aging boxer Bill Thompson always lost his past fights, his corrupt manager, without telling Thompson, takes bribes from a betting gangster, to ensure Thompson's pre-arranged dive-loss in the next match.
Two criminals on the run end up working in a rice field and decide to recruit other workers for their next robbery.
A letter is addressed to three wives from their "best friend" Addie Ross, announcing that she is running away with one of their husbands - but she does not say which one.
A hard-as-nails general takes over a bomber unit suffering from low morale and whips them into fighting shape.
1941 in a small town in Nazi occupied France. Against the will of its elderly male and his adult niece residents, the Nazis commandeer a house for one of their officers, Lt. Werner von ...
A war-veteran-turned-truck driver attempts to avenge the crippling and robbing of his father at the hands of an amoral produce scofflaw.
An embittered, vengeful POW stalks his former commanding officer who betrayed his men's planned escape attempt from a Nazi prison camp.
Domestic and professional tensions mount when a husband and wife work as opposing lawyers in a case involving a woman who shot her husband.
The rise and fall of a corrupt politician, who makes his friends richer and retains power by dint of a populist appeal.
True tale about a squad of the 101st Airborne Division coping with being trapped by the Germans in the besieged city of Bastogne, Belgium during the Battle of the Bulge in December of 1944.
Boxer Midge Kelly rises to fame...mainly by stepping on other people.
Three sailors on a day of shore leave in New York City look for fun and romance before their twenty-four hours are up.
To avoid the heat of a sweltering summer night a 9-year-old Manhattan boy decides to sleep on the fire escape and witnesses a murder, but no one will believe him.
A group of sisters experience life's difficulties and its pleasures while growing up in nineteenth-century America.
Captain Nathan Brittles, on the eve of retirement, takes out a last patrol to stop an impending massive Indian attack. Encumbered by women who must be evacuated, Brittles finds his mission imperiled.
Through a fluke circumstance, a ruthless woman stumbles across a suitcase filled with $60,000, and is determined to hold onto it even if it means murder.
Frank Bigelow, told he's been poisoned and has only a few days to live, tries to find out who killed him and why.
A young widow is romanced by a sales clerk whom she inadvertently got fired.
In turn-of-the century America, Andrew and Veronica are co-workers in a music shop who dislike one another during business hours but unwittingly carry on an anonymous romance through the mail.
After discovering the dead body of her teenage daughter's lover, a housewife takes desperate measures to protect her family from scandal.
Scottish islanders try to plunder 50,000 cases of whisky from a stranded ship.
An uncompromising, visionary architect struggles to maintain his integrity and individualism despite personal, professional and economic pressures to conform to popular standards.
A unfaithful wife plots with her lover to kill her husband, but the lover is accidentally killed instead. The husband stays in hiding, and lets his wife be charged with conspiracy.
Residents of a part of London declare independence when they discover an old treaty. This leads to the need for a "Passport to Pimlico".
A dramatization of the World War II Battle of Iwo Jima.
An L.A. department store ambitious young model gets her wish of marrying a millionaire but she eventually discovers that rich life isn't always a happy one.

movies.t: The Adventures of Ichabod and Mr. Toad
movies.a: Le avventure di Ichabod e Mr. Toad
movies.s: An animated adaptation of "The Wind in the Willows" followed by an adaptation of "The Legend of Sleepy Hollow".
An army lieutenant accused of robbery pursues the real thief on a frantic chase through Mexico aided by the thief's fiancee.
A young woman who has raised a giant gorilla from an infant brings him to Hollywood years later seeking her fortune.

movies.t: Bud Abbott Lou Costello Meet the Killer Boris Karloff
movies.a: Gianni e Pinotto e l'assassino misterioso
movies.s: Two employees of a secluded hotel investigate a murder on the premises in which the goofy bellboy is the prime suspect.
When strongman Samson rejects the love of the beautiful Philistine woman Delilah, she seeks vengeance that brings horrible consequences they both regret.

movies.t: Take Me Out to the Ball Game
movies.s: Two turn-of-the-century baseball players, who work in vaudeville during the off-season, run into trouble with their team's new female owner and a gambler who doesn't want them to win the pennant.
Abbott & Costello search for diamonds in Africa, along the way meeting a visually-impaired gunner, a hungry lion, and a tribe of cannibals...
A young gentleman goes to Australia where he reunites with his now married childhood sweetheart, only to find out she has become an alcoholic and harbors dark secrets.
In post-war Italy, a working-class man's bicycle is stolen. He and his son set out to find it.

movies.t: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
movies.s: Two Americans searching for work in Mexico convince an old prospector to help them mine for gold in the Sierra Madre Mountains.
A young ballet dancer is torn between the man she loves and her pursuit to become a prima ballerina.
A pianist about to flee from a duel receives a letter from a woman he cannot remember, who may hold the key to his downfall.
Two men attempt to prove they committed the perfect crime by hosting a dinner party after strangling their former classmate to death.
A young German boy faces the problems of the tough life in the immediate post WWII Berlin.
The ups and downs of a Norwegian immigrant family, circa 1910.
A man visits his war buddy's family hotel and finds a gangster running things. As a hurricane approaches, the two end up confronting each other.
An orphan named Oliver Twist meets a pickpocket on the streets of London. From there, he joins a household of boys who are trained to steal for their master.
Dunson leads a cattle drive, the culmination of over 14 years of work, to its destination in Missouri. But his tyrannical behavior along the way causes a mutiny, led by his adopted son.
In post-war Berlin, an American private helps a lost Czech boy find his mother.
In rural Sicily, the fishermen live at the mercy of the greedy wholesalers. One family risks everything to buy their own boat and operate independently.
A magazine tycoon commits a murder and pins it on an innocent man, who then tries to solve the murder himself.
A butler working in a foreign embassy in London falls under suspicion when his wife accidentally falls to her death, the only witness being an impressionable young boy.
In post-war Cape Breton, a doctor's efforts to tutor a deaf/mute woman are undermined when she is raped, and the resulting pregnancy causes scandal to swirl.
A mysterious girl inspires a struggling artist.
A drunken doctor with a hot temper and a violence-prone gangster with tuberculosis form a quicksilver bond.
Prince Hamlet struggles over whether or not he should kill his uncle, whom he suspects has murdered his father, the former king.
A step-by-step look at a murder investigation on the streets of New York.
A detailed chronicle of a woman during her stay in a mental institution.
While conducting a symphony orchestra, Sir Alfred De Carter imagines three different ways of dealing with his wife's suspected infidelity, then tries acting out his fantasies, but things do...
At Fort Apache, an honorable and veteran war captain finds conflict when his regime is placed under the command of a young, glory hungry lieutenant colonel with no respect for the local Indian tribe.

Macbeth, the Thane of Glamis, receives a prophecy from a trio of witches that one day he will become King of Scotland. Consumed by ambition and spurred to action by his wife, Macbeth murders his king and takes the throne for himself.
An escaped convict, injured during a robbery, falls in love with the woman who nurses him back to health, but their relationship seems doomed from the beginning.
In Brighton in 1935, small-time gang leader Pinkie Brown murders a journalist and later desperately tries to cover his tracks but runs into trouble with the police, a few witnesses and a rival gang.

movies.t: Bud Abbott Lou Costello Meet Frankenstein
movies.s: Two hapless freight handlers find themselves encountering Dracula, the Frankenstein Monster and the Wolf Man.
Chicago reporter P.J. McNeal re-opens a ten year old murder case.
A nightclub performer hires a naive chorus girl to become his new dance partner to make his former partner jealous and to prove he can make any partner a star.
While on the telephone, an invalid woman overhears what she thinks is a murder plot and attempts to prevent it.
A pistol-packing tomboy and her grandfather discover a band of bank robbing bandits taking refuge in the neighboring ghost town.
An unethical lawyer, with an older brother he wants to help, becomes a partner with a client in the numbers racket.
In occupied Berlin, an army captain is torn between an ex-Nazi café singer and the U.S. congresswoman investigating her.

movies.t: Mr. Blandings Builds His Dream House
movies.s: A man and his wife decide they can afford to have a house in the country built to their specifications. It's a lot more trouble than they think.
This film-noir piece, told in semi-documentary style, follows police on the hunt for a resourceful criminal who shoots and kills a cop.
Joe Sullivan has taken the rap for Rick who double-crosses him with a flawed escape plan and other means intended to get rid of him.
An industrialist is urged to run for President, but this requires uncomfortable compromises on both political and marital levels.
D'Artagnan (Gene Kelly) and his Musketeer comrades thwart the plans of Cardinal Richelieu (Vincent Price) to usurp King Louis XIII's (Frank Morgan's) power.
Three outlaws on the run find a dying woman in the desert who gives birth to a baby. The mother entrusts the care of the child to the three men.
A girl is engaged to the local richman, but meanwhile she has dreams about the legendary pirate Macoco. A traveling singer falls in love with her and to impress her he poses as the pirate.
Calamity Jane is despatched to find out who's smuggling rifles to the Indians, and winds up married to a hapless correspondence school dentist as part of her cover.
An anthology of animated vignettes set to contemporary music.

A private eye escapes his past to run a gas station in a small town, but his past catches up with him. Now he must return to the big city world of danger, corruption, double crosses and duplicitous dames.

movies.a: Il fantasma e la signora Muir
movies.s: In 1900, a young widow finds her seaside cottage is haunted and forms a unique relationship with the ghost.
When a nice old man who claims to be Santa Claus is institutionalized as insane, a young lawyer decides to defend him by arguing in court that he is the real thing.
A suave but cynical man supports his family by marrying and murdering rich women for their money, but the job has some occupational hazards.

After opening a convent in the Himalayas, five nuns encounter conflict and tension - both with the natives and also within their own group - as they attempt to adapt to their remote, exotic surroundings.
Jenny Lamour wants to succeed in music hall. Her husband and accompanist is Maurice Martineau, a nice but jealous man. When he knew Jenny is making eyes at Brignon, an old businessman, in ...
A homeless New Yorker moves into a mansion and along the way he gathers friends to live in the house with him. Before he knows it, he is living with the actual home owners.
A wounded Irish nationalist leader attempts to evade police following a failed robbery in Belfast.
An angel in human form enters the life of a bishop in order to help him build a new cathedral and repair his fractured marriage.
A talented boxer's young career hits difficult terrain when an unethical promoter takes interest in him.
At a tough penitentiary, prisoner Joe Collins plans to rebel against Captain Munsey, the power-mad chief guard.
Fascinated by gorgeous Mrs. Bannister, seaman Michael O'Hara joins a bizarre yachting cruise, and ends up mired in a complex murder plot.
A man convicted of murdering his wife escapes from prison and works with a woman to try and prove his innocence.
A high school girl falls for a playboy artist, with screwball results.
The true story of a prosecutor's fight to prove the innocence of a man accused of a notorious murder.
A calculating divorcée risks her chances at wealth and security with a man she doesn't love by getting involved with the hotheaded murderer romancing her foster sister.
A reporter pretends to be Jewish in order to cover a story on anti-Semitism, and personally discovers the true depths of bigotry and hatred.
A financier from New York City rules his numerous family, consisting of his wife and his four sons, with the meticulousness of a bookkeeper.
After being found wandering the streets of Los Angeles, a severely catatonic woman tells a doctor the complex story of how she wound up there.
A soldier runs away rather than receive the Medal of Honor, so his buddy gets permission to investigate, and love and death soon follow.
Nick and Nora investigate the murder of a bandleader in New York.
Two inept vaudevillians stow away on a Brazilian-bound ocean liner and foil a plot by a sinister hypnotist to marry off her niece to a greedy fortune hunter.

movies.t: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty
movies.s: A clumsy daydreamer gets caught up in a sinister conspiracy.
Two US Treasury agents hunt a successful counterfeiting ring.

Quirt Evans, an all round bad guy, is nursed back to health and sought after by Penelope Worth, a Quaker girl. He eventually finds himself having to choose between his world and the world Penelope lives in.
An artist forms an attachment with a woman on holiday in the country. As the relationship develops, his behavior and information about his past cause her increasing concern.
An old man and his sister are concealing a terrible secret from their adopted teen daughter, concerning a hidden abandoned farmhouse, located deep in the woods.
When a lovely woman and her new husband settle in an ancient mansion on the East coast, she discovers that he may want to kill her.
Jiminy Cricket hosts two Disney animated shorts: "Bongo," about a circus bear escaping to the wild, and "Mickey and the Beanstalk," a take on the famous fairy tale.
A happily married London barrister falls in love with the accused poisoner he is defending.
An angel is sent from Heaven to help a desperately frustrated businessman by showing him what life would have been like if he had never existed.

movies.t: A Matter of Life and Death
movies.s: A British wartime aviator who cheats death must argue for his life before a celestial court.

movies.t: The Best Years of Our Lives
movies.a: I migliori anni della nostra vita
movies.s: Three World War II veterans return home to small-town America to discover that they and their families have been irreparably changed.

Two shoeshine boys in postwar Rome, Italy, save up to buy a horse, but their involvement as dupes in a burglary lands them in juvenile prison where the experience take a devastating toll on their friendship.
A beautiful young woman takes her father's place as the prisoner of a mysterious beast, who wishes to marry her.
Private detective Philip Marlowe is hired by a wealthy family. Before the complex case is over, he's seen murder, blackmail, and what might be love.
A woman is asked to spy on a group of Nazi friends in South America. How far will she have to go to ingratiate herself with them?
A humble orphan suddenly becomes a gentleman with the help of an unknown benefactor.
Hit men kill an unresisting victim, and investigator Reardon uncovers his past involvement with beautiful, deadly Kitty Collins.
The Earps battle the Clantons at the OK Corral in Tombstone, Arizona.
A small-time gambler hired to work in a Buenos Aires casino discovers his employer's new wife is his former lover.
After the nurse who declares that a recent surgical death was a murder dies also, an enigmatic Scotland Yard inspector arrives to investigate.

movies.a: Il postino suona sempre due volte
